units.title: Relationships and emotions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

items.en: and; as well as; and so

ex.zh: 我要的不是茶，而是咖啡。
ex.p: wǒ yào de bù shì chá ér shì kā fēi
ex.en: What I want isn't tea, but coffee.

ex.zh: 这本书对我而言太贵了。
ex.p: zhè běn shū duì wǒ ér yán tài guì le
ex.en: This book is too expensive for me.

ex.zh: 我不知道我们将会做什么。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ men jiāng huì zuò shén me
ex.en: I don't know what we'll do.

ex.zh: 不管怎样，我们所有人都将死。
ex.p: bù guǎn zěn yàng wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu jiāng sǐ
ex.en: We're all going to die anyway.

ex.zh: 你就是我一直要找的人。
ex.p: nǐ jiù shì wǒ yī zhí yào zhǎo de rén
ex.en: You're the man I've been looking for.

ex.zh: 我就是想让你看看这个。
ex.p: wǒ jiù shì xiǎng ràng nǐ kàn kàn zhè gè
ex.en: I just wanted you to look at this.

ex.zh: 行与行之间多留些空间。
ex.p: xíng yú xíng zhī jiān duō liú xiē kōng jiān
ex.en: Leave more space between the lines.

ex.zh: 您觉得您无法与他人交流吗？
ex.p: nín jué de nín wú fǎ yú tā rén jiāo liú ma
ex.en: Do you feel like you can't connect with other people?

ex.zh: 他们说了什么，我并不注意。
ex.p: tā men shuō le shén me wǒ bìng bù zhù yì
ex.en: I didn't pay attention to what they were saying.

ex.zh: 哪个队赢得比赛并不重要。
ex.p: nǎ gè duì yíng dé bǐ sài bìng bù zhòng yào
ex.en: It doesn't matter which team wins the game.

ex.zh: 当时我什么都不能做。
ex.p: dāng shí wǒ shén me dōu bù néng zuò
ex.en: There was nothing I could do at that time.

ex.zh: 他当时一个人在家。
ex.p: tā dāng shí yī gè rén zài jiā
ex.en: He was home alone at the time.

items.en: (possessive particle, literary equivalent of 的); him; her

ex.zh: 你觉得我之前在做什么？
ex.p: nǐ jué de wǒ zhī qián zài zuò shén me
ex.en: What do you think I've been doing?

ex.zh: 我之前已经来过这里了。
ex.p: wǒ zhī qián yǐ jīng lái guò zhè lǐ le
ex.en: I've been here before.

ex.zh: 他们要求马上把国王处死。
ex.p: tā men yāo qiú mǎ shàng bǎ guó wáng chù sǐ
ex.en: They demanded the king be put to death at once.

ex.zh: 这是一个生和死的问题。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè shēng hé sǐ de wèn tí
ex.en: It's a matter of life and death.

ex.zh: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。
ex.p: nǐ huó zhe dàn shì què bù zhī dào wèi shén me huó zhe
ex.en: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.

ex.zh: 我要的是茶，而他却给了我一杯咖啡。
ex.p: wǒ yào de shì chá ér tā què gěi le wǒ yī bēi kā fēi
ex.en: He brought me coffee, when I had asked for tea.

items.en: all; to have; to possess; to own

ex.zh: 我们所有的努力都白费了。
ex.p: wǒ men suǒ yǒu de nǔ lì dōu bái fèi le
ex.en: All our efforts were in vain.

ex.zh: 所有你能做的就是等待。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu nǐ néng zuò de jiù shì děng dài
ex.en: All you can do is wait.

ex.zh: 请把真实的情况说出来。
ex.p: qǐng bǎ zhēn shí de qíng kuàng shuō chū lái
ex.en: Please tell the truth.

ex.zh: 在这种情况下，他们该做什么？
ex.p: zài zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng xià tā men gāi zuò shén me
ex.en: What should they do in this situation?

ex.zh: 他会成为一个好的医生的。
ex.p: tā huì chéng wéi yī gè hǎo de yī shēng de
ex.en: He will be a good doctor.

ex.zh: 他长大了会成为一名医生。
ex.p: tā zhǎng dà le huì chéng wéi yī míng yī shēng
ex.en: He will be a doctor when he grows up.

items.en: feeling; impression; sensation; to feel; to perceive

ex.zh: 我从来没感觉那么好过。
ex.p: wǒ cóng lái méi gǎn jué nà me hǎo guò
ex.en: I've never felt better.

ex.zh: 我感觉你想告诉我什么事。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn jué nǐ xiǎng gào sù wǒ shén me shì
ex.en: I get the feeling you're trying to tell me something.

items.en: to continue; to proceed with; to go on with

ex.zh: 我们要继续我们的工作。
ex.p: wǒ men yào jì xù wǒ men de gōng zuò
ex.en: We have to continue to do our jobs.

ex.zh: 我没力气继续尝试了。
ex.p: wǒ méi lì qi jì xù cháng shì le
ex.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.

ex.zh: 我会开车送你们去机场。
ex.p: wǒ huì kāi chē sòng nǐ men qù jī chǎng
ex.en: I'll drive you to the airport.

ex.zh: 你知道商场什么时候关门吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào shāng chǎng shén me shí hou guān mén ma
ex.en: Do you know when the supermarket closes?

ex.zh: 今天太热了，我没心情学习。
ex.p: jīn tiān tài rè le wǒ méi xīn qíng xué xí
ex.en: I don't feel like studying today in this heat.

ex.zh: 今晚我没心情出去吃饭。
ex.p: jīn wǎn wǒ méi xīn qíng chū qù chī fàn
ex.en: I don't feel like eating out this evening.

ex.zh: 该项目正在进行中。
ex.p: gāi xiàng mù zhèng zài jìn xíng zhōng
ex.en: The project is ongoing.

ex.zh: 她现在应该已经到家了。
ex.p: tā xiàn zài yīng gāi yǐ jīng dào jiā le
ex.en: She should have arrived home by now.

ex.zh: 我已经找了很久的工作。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng zhǎo le hěn jiǔ de gōng zuò
ex.en: I've been looking for a new job for a long time.

ex.zh: 四月之后是五月。
ex.p: sì yuè zhī hòu shì wǔ yuè
ex.en: May comes after April.

ex.zh: 他们四十分钟之后下课。
ex.p: tā men sì shí fēn zhōng zhī hòu xià kè
ex.en: They'll get out of class in forty minutes.

ex.zh: 我们必须在五分钟之内离开。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū zài wǔ fēn zhōng zhī nèi lí kāi
ex.en: We have to leave in five minutes.

ex.zh: 我会一周内完成这个工作的。
ex.p: wǒ huì yī zhōu nèi wán chéng zhè gè gōng zuò de
ex.en: I will get the work done in a week.

items.en: to appear; to arise; to emerge

ex.zh: 一辈子只会出现一次像这样的机会。
ex.p: yī bèi zi zhǐ huì chū xiàn yī cì xiàng zhè yàng de jī huì
ex.en: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.

ex.zh: 一个男的突然出现在门口。
ex.p: yī gè nán de tū rán chū xiàn zài mén kǒu
ex.en: A man suddenly appeared in the doorway.

ex.zh: 谁选你来做这个任务？
ex.p: shéi xuǎn nǐ lái zuò zhè gè rèn wu
ex.en: Who picked you for this mission?

ex.zh: 他老了，所以这任务对他来说一定很难。
ex.p: tā lǎo le suǒ yǐ zhè rèn wu duì tā lái shuō yī dìng hěn nán
ex.en: Since he is old, this task must be difficult for him.

items.en: not to be concerned; regardless of; no matter

ex.zh: 不管问了什么，她都能回答。
ex.p: bù guǎn wèn le shén me tā dōu néng huí dá
ex.en: She was able to answer whatever was asked.

ex.zh: 不管是谁总比没人好。
ex.p: bù guǎn shì shéi zǒng bǐ méi rén hǎo
ex.en: Anybody would be better than nobody.

ex.zh: 我说我会让她幸福的。
ex.p: wǒ shuō wǒ huì ràng tā xìng fú de
ex.en: I said I would make her happy.

ex.zh: 我相信他是幸福的。
ex.p: wǒ xiāng xìn tā shì xìng fú de
ex.en: I believe that he's happy.

ex.zh: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。
ex.p: tā men fēn fáng shuì jí shǐ tā men yǐ jīng jié hūn le
ex.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.

ex.zh: 即使我知道答案，我也不会告诉你。
ex.p: jí shǐ wǒ zhī dào dá àn wǒ yě bù huì gào sù nǐ
ex.en: Even if I knew the answer, I wouldn't tell you.

items.en: no matter what or how; regardless of whether...

ex.zh: 无论我做什么，你都不高兴。
ex.p: wú lùn wǒ zuò shén me nǐ dōu bù gāo xìng
ex.en: You won't be happy no matter what I do.

ex.zh: 无论你要我做什么，我都会去做的。
ex.p: wú lùn nǐ yào wǒ zuò shén me wǒ dū huì qù zuò de
ex.en: I'll do whatever you want me to do.

ex.zh: 大家都玩爱情游戏。
ex.p: dà jiā dōu wán ài qíng yóu xì
ex.en: Everybody plays the game of love.

ex.zh: 我相信爱情。
ex.p: wǒ xiāng xìn ài qíng
ex.en: I believe in love.

ex.zh: 我很抱歉伤害了你的感情。
ex.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn shāng hài le nǐ de gǎn qíng
ex.en: I'm so sorry I hurt your feelings.

ex.zh: 她很容易受到感情上的伤害。
ex.p: tā hěn róng yì shòu dào gǎn qíng shǎng de shāng hài
ex.en: Her feelings are easily hurt.

items.en: exterior surface; family relationship via females; to show (one's opinion)

ex.zh: 他去和他的表弟待在一起了。
ex.p: tā qù hé tā de biǎo dì dāi zài yī qǐ le
ex.en: He went to stay with his cousin.

ex.zh: 我将给儿子买块手表。
ex.p: wǒ jiāng gěi ér zi mǎi kuài shǒu biǎo
ex.en: I'll buy a watch for my son.

items.en: to leave out; to be missing; to leave behind or forget to bring

ex.zh: 他把眼镜落在我们这里了。
ex.p: tā bǎ yǎn jìng là zài wǒ men zhè lǐ le
ex.en: He left his glasses at our place.

ex.zh: 我们能从窗户看到日落。
ex.p: wǒ men néng cóng chuāng hu kàn dào rì là
ex.en: We could see the sunset from the window.

ex.zh: 快点，不然你就要错过火车了。
ex.p: kuài diǎn bù rán nǐ jiù yào cuò guò huǒ chē le
ex.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.

ex.zh: 我不想错过我的火车。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng cuò guò wǒ de huǒ chē
ex.en: I don't want to miss my train.

items.en: since; as; this being the case

ex.zh: 既然母亲病了，我就待在家里没去上学。
ex.p: jì rán mǔ qīn bìng le wǒ jiù dāi zài jiā lǐ méi qù shàng xué
ex.en: Since my mother was sick, I stayed home from school.

items.en: to move emotionally; to stir up (emotions); to excite

ex.zh: 我快要激动得说不出话来了。
ex.p: wǒ kuài yào jī dòng de shuō bù chū huà lái le
ex.en: I'm getting choked up.

ex.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。
ex.p: tài kōng pǎo bù shì lì shǐ shǎng jī dòng rén xīn de shí kè
ex.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.

items.en: to move (sb); to touch (sb emotionally); moving

ex.zh: 这件事真的感动到我了。
ex.p: zhè jiàn shì zhēn de gǎn dòng dào wǒ le
ex.en: I was really moved by this.

ex.zh: 这件事让我真的很感动。
ex.p: zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎn dòng
ex.en: I was really moved by this.

ex.zh: 我们的友谊受到了考验。
ex.p: wǒ men de yǒu yì shòu dào le kǎo yàn
ex.en: Our friendship was put to the test.

ex.zh: 友谊紧紧联系着我们。
ex.p: yǒu yì jǐn jǐn lián xì zhe wǒ men
ex.en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.

ex.zh: 还有什么比友情更好呢？
ex.p: hái yǒu shén me bǐ yǒu qíng gēng hǎo ne
ex.en: What is better than friendship?

ex.zh: 他们的友情深深地感动了我们。
ex.p: tā men de yǒu qíng shēn shēn de gǎn dòng le wǒ men
ex.en: Their friendship moved us deeply.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第46单元

Relationships and emotions

Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.en: I get the feeling you're trying to tell me something.

sents.zh: 我们要继续我们的工作。
sents.p: wǒ men yào jì xù wǒ men de gōng zuò
sents.en: We have to continue to do our jobs.

sents.zh: 我没力气继续尝试了。
sents.p: wǒ méi lì qi jì xù cháng shì le
sents.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.

sents.zh: 我会开车送你们去机场。
sents.p: wǒ huì kāi chē sòng nǐ men qù jī chǎng
sents.en: I'll drive you to the airport.

sents.zh: 你知道商场什么时候关门吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào shāng chǎng shén me shí hou guān mén ma
sents.en: Do you know when the supermarket closes?

sents.zh: 今天太热了，我没心情学习。
sents.p: jīn tiān tài rè le wǒ méi xīn qíng xué xí
sents.en: I don't feel like studying today in this heat.

sents.zh: 今晚我没心情出去吃饭。
sents.p: jīn wǎn wǒ méi xīn qíng chū qù chī fàn
sents.en: I don't feel like eating out this evening.

sents.zh: 该项目正在进行中。
sents.p: gāi xiàng mù zhèng zài jìn xíng zhōng
sents.en: The project is ongoing.

sents.zh: 她现在应该已经到家了。
sents.p: tā xiàn zài yīng gāi yǐ jīng dào jiā le
sents.en: She should have arrived home by now.

sents.zh: 我已经找了很久的工作。
sents.p: wǒ yǐ jīng zhǎo le hěn jiǔ de gōng zuò
sents.en: I've been looking for a new job for a long time.

sents.zh: 四月之后是五月。
sents.p: sì yuè zhī hòu shì wǔ yuè
sents.en: May comes after April.

sents.zh: 他们四十分钟之后下课。
sents.p: tā men sì shí fēn zhōng zhī hòu xià kè
sents.en: They'll get out of class in forty minutes.

sents.zh: 我们必须在五分钟之内离开。
sents.p: wǒ men bì xū zài wǔ fēn zhōng zhī nèi lí kāi
sents.en: We have to leave in five minutes.

sents.zh: 我会一周内完成这个工作的。
sents.p: wǒ huì yī zhōu nèi wán chéng zhè gè gōng zuò de
sents.en: I will get the work done in a week.

sents.zh: 一辈子只会出现一次像这样的机会。
sents.p: yī bèi zi zhǐ huì chū xiàn yī cì xiàng zhè yàng de jī huì
sents.en: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.

sents.zh: 一个男的突然出现在门口。
sents.p: yī gè nán de tū rán chū xiàn zài mén kǒu
sents.en: A man suddenly appeared in the doorway.

sents.zh: 谁选你来做这个任务？
sents.p: shéi xuǎn nǐ lái zuò zhè gè rèn wu
sents.en: Who picked you for this mission?

sents.zh: 他老了，所以这任务对他来说一定很难。
sents.p: tā lǎo le suǒ yǐ zhè rèn wu duì tā lái shuō yī dìng hěn nán
sents.en: Since he is old, this task must be difficult for him.

sents.zh: 不管问了什么，她都能回答。
sents.p: bù guǎn wèn le shén me tā dōu néng huí dá
sents.en: She was able to answer whatever was asked.

sents.zh: 不管是谁总比没人好。
sents.p: bù guǎn shì shéi zǒng bǐ méi rén hǎo
sents.en: Anybody would be better than nobody.

sents.zh: 我说我会让她幸福的。
sents.p: wǒ shuō wǒ huì ràng tā xìng fú de
sents.en: I said I would make her happy.

sents.zh: 我相信他是幸福的。
sents.p: wǒ xiāng xìn tā shì xìng fú de
sents.en: I believe that he's happy.

sents.zh: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。
sents.p: tā men fēn fáng shuì jí shǐ tā men yǐ jīng jié hūn le
sents.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.

sents.zh: 即使我知道答案，我也不会告诉你。
sents.p: jí shǐ wǒ zhī dào dá àn wǒ yě bù huì gào sù nǐ
sents.en: Even if I knew the answer, I wouldn't tell you.

sents.zh: 无论我做什么，你都不高兴。
sents.p: wú lùn wǒ zuò shén me nǐ dōu bù gāo xìng
sents.en: You won't be happy no matter what I do.

sents.zh: 无论你要我做什么，我都会去做的。
sents.p: wú lùn nǐ yào wǒ zuò shén me wǒ dū huì qù zuò de
sents.en: I'll do whatever you want me to do.

sents.zh: 大家都玩爱情游戏。
sents.p: dà jiā dōu wán ài qíng yóu xì
sents.en: Everybody plays the game of love.

sents.zh: 我相信爱情。
sents.p: wǒ xiāng xìn ài qíng
sents.en: I believe in love.

sents.zh: 我很抱歉伤害了你的感情。
sents.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn shāng hài le nǐ de gǎn qíng
sents.en: I'm so sorry I hurt your feelings.

sents.zh: 她很容易受到感情上的伤害。
sents.p: tā hěn róng yì shòu dào gǎn qíng shǎng de shāng hài
sents.en: Her feelings are easily hurt.

sents.zh: 他去和他的表弟待在一起了。
sents.p: tā qù hé tā de biǎo dì dāi zài yī qǐ le
sents.en: He went to stay with his cousin.

sents.zh: 我将给儿子买块手表。
sents.p: wǒ jiāng gěi ér zi mǎi kuài shǒu biǎo
sents.en: I'll buy a watch for my son.

sents.zh: 他把眼镜落在我们这里了。
sents.p: tā bǎ yǎn jìng là zài wǒ men zhè lǐ le
sents.en: He left his glasses at our place.

sents.zh: 我们能从窗户看到日落。
sents.p: wǒ men néng cóng chuāng hu kàn dào rì là
sents.en: We could see the sunset from the window.

sents.zh: 快点，不然你就要错过火车了。
sents.p: kuài diǎn bù rán nǐ jiù yào cuò guò huǒ chē le
sents.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.

sents.zh: 我不想错过我的火车。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng cuò guò wǒ de huǒ chē
sents.en: I don't want to miss my train.

sents.zh: 既然母亲病了，我就待在家里没去上学。
sents.p: jì rán mǔ qīn bìng le wǒ jiù dāi zài jiā lǐ méi qù shàng xué
sents.en: Since my mother was sick, I stayed home from school.

sents.zh: 我快要激动得说不出话来了。
sents.p: wǒ kuài yào jī dòng de shuō bù chū huà lái le
sents.en: I'm getting choked up.

sents.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。
sents.p: tài kōng pǎo bù shì lì shǐ shǎng jī dòng rén xīn de shí kè
sents.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.

sents.zh: 这件事真的感动到我了。
sents.p: zhè jiàn shì zhēn de gǎn dòng dào wǒ le
sents.en: I was really moved by this.

sents.zh: 这件事让我真的很感动。
sents.p: zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎn dòng
sents.en: I was really moved by this.

sents.zh: 我们的友谊受到了考验。
sents.p: wǒ men de yǒu yì shòu dào le kǎo yàn
sents.en: Our friendship was put to the test.

sents.zh: 友谊紧紧联系着我们。
sents.p: yǒu yì jǐn jǐn lián xì zhe wǒ men
sents.en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.

sents.zh: 还有什么比友情更好呢？
sents.p: hái yǒu shén me bǐ yǒu qíng gēng hǎo ne
sents.en: What is better than friendship?

sents.zh: 他们的友情深深地感动了我们。
sents.p: tā men de yǒu qíng shēn shēn de gǎn dòng le wǒ men
sents.en: Their friendship moved us deeply.

units.title: Relationships and emotions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

items.en: the Americas (abbr. for 洲); USA (abbr. for 美国)

ex.zh: 你做了一项完美的工作。
ex.p: nǐ zuò le yī xiàng wán měi de gōng zuò
ex.en: You've done a perfect job.

ex.zh: 有很多美国人会说日语。
ex.p: yǒu hěn duō měi guó rén huì shuō rì yǔ
ex.en: There are many Americans who can speak Japanese.

items.en: to pass through; to get through

ex.zh: 我必须通过这场考试。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū tōng guò zhè cháng kǎo shì
ex.en: I have to pass this exam.

ex.zh: 我不想不通过考试。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng bù tōng guò kǎo shì
ex.en: I don't want to fail my exams.

ex.zh: 他们的计划我一无所知。
ex.p: tā men de jì huà wǒ yī wú suǒ zhī
ex.en: I am quite ignorant of their plan.

ex.zh: 她无所事事地看向窗外
ex.p: tā wú suǒ shì shì de kàn xiàng chuāng wài
ex.en: She was idly looking out of the window.

ex.zh: 这是你所能做的一切了。
ex.p: zhè shì nǐ suǒ néng zuò de yī qiè le
ex.en: It's all you can really do.

ex.zh: 重力将一切带下地球表面。
ex.p: zhòng lì jiāng yī qiè dài xià dì qiú biǎo miàn
ex.en: Gravity brings everything down to Earth.

items.en: to follow; from; because of; due to

ex.zh: 从现在开始，由她来照顾你。
ex.p: cóng xiàn zài kāi shǐ yóu tā lái zhào gu nǐ
ex.en: She will care for you from now on.

ex.zh: 她有三个孩子，信不信由你。
ex.p: tā yǒu sān gè hái zi xìn bù xìn yóu nǐ
ex.en: Believe it or not, she has three children.

ex.zh: 他这么做，没有任何不安。
ex.p: tā zhè me zuò méi yǒu rèn hé bù ān
ex.en: He had no qualms in doing so.

ex.zh: 你可以做任何你想做的事。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ zuò rèn hé nǐ xiǎng zuò de shì
ex.en: You can do whatever you want to.

ex.zh: 他来还是不来，结果是一样的。
ex.p: tā lái hái shi bù lái jiē guǒ shì yī yàng de
ex.en: Whether he comes or not, the result will be the same.

ex.zh: 他们对结果很满意。
ex.p: tā men duì jiē guǒ hěn mǎn yì
ex.en: They are happy with the result.

ex.zh: 你觉得对此该做什么？
ex.p: nǐ jué de duì cǐ gāi zuò shén me
ex.en: What do you think should be done about it?

ex.zh: 早知如此，就不应该借钱给他。
ex.p: zǎo zhī rú cǐ jiù bù yīng gāi jiè qián gěi tā
ex.en: You should have known better than to lend him money.

ex.zh: 这人讲的我完全听不懂。
ex.p: zhè rén jiǎng de wǒ wán quán yǐn bù dǒng
ex.en: What he said was over my head.

ex.zh: 我们完全没有共同点。
ex.p: wǒ men wán quán méi yǒu gòng tóng diǎn
ex.en: We have absolutely nothing in common.

items.en: to make; to cause; to enable

ex.zh: 他使他儿子成了个有钱人。
ex.p: tā shǐ tā ér zi chéng le gè yǒu qián rén
ex.en: He made his son a wealthy man.

ex.zh: 你们该养成使用字典的习惯。
ex.p: nǐ men gāi yǎng chéng shǐ yòng zì diǎn de xí guàn
ex.en: You should try to form the habit of using your dictionaries.

ex.zh: 我们在这里应该是安全的。
ex.p: wǒ men zài zhè lǐ yīng gāi shì ān quán de
ex.en: We should be safe here.

ex.zh: 你和我在这里很安全。
ex.p: nǐ hé wǒ zài zhè lǐ hěn ān quán
ex.en: You're safe here with me.

ex.zh: 我们队从来就没赢过。
ex.p: wǒ men duì cóng lái jiù méi yíng guò
ex.en: My team is always losing.

ex.zh: 我们要你做队长。
ex.p: wǒ men yào nǐ zuò duì zhǎng
ex.en: We want you to be the team captain.

ex.zh: 他们是从法国南部来的。
ex.p: tā men shì cóng fǎ guó nán bù lái de
ex.en: They come from the south of France.

ex.zh: 他的故事一部分是真的。
ex.p: tā de gù shì yī bù fen shì zhēn de
ex.en: Part of his story is true.

ex.zh: 他的失败看来有几个原因。
ex.p: tā de shī bài kàn lai yǒu jī gè yuán yīn
ex.en: There seem to be several reasons for his failure.

ex.zh: 我知道你不想去的真实原因。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào nǐ bù xiǎng qù de zhēn shí yuán yīn
ex.en: I know the real reason you don't want to go.

ex.zh: 我只是听到了一些消息。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ shì tīng dào le yī xiē xiāo xi
ex.en: I just heard something.

ex.zh: 我有一些非常好的消息。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu yī xiē fēi cháng hǎo de xiāo xi
ex.en: I have some very good news.

items.en: to show; to show off; to display

ex.zh: 有时候成人表现得像儿童。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou chéng rén biǎo xiàn de xiàng ér tóng
ex.en: Sometimes adults behave like children.

items.en: to enter; to join; to go into

ex.zh: 他不接受我的道歉。
ex.p: tā bù jiē shòu wǒ de dào qiàn
ex.en: He did not accept my apologies.

ex.zh: 他接受了她的礼物。
ex.p: tā jiē shòu le tā de lǐ wù
ex.en: He accepted her gift.

ex.zh: 其中一个学生今天没来。
ex.p: qí zhōng yī gè xué sheng jīn tiān méi lái
ex.en: One of the students didn't come today.

ex.zh: 我的其中一个行李不见了。
ex.p: wǒ de qí zhōng yī gè xíng li bù jiàn le
ex.en: One of my suitcases is missing.

items.en: Chenggong or Chengkung town in Taitung County 台东县, southeast Taiwan

ex.zh: 我很高兴知道你成功了。
ex.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng zhī dào nǐ chéng gōng le
ex.en: I was glad to hear of your success.

ex.zh: 我成功地得到了我想要的。
ex.p: wǒ chéng gōng de dé dào le wǒ xiǎng yào de
ex.en: I succeeded in getting what I wanted.

ex.zh: 我们之间肯定有误会。
ex.p: wǒ men zhī jiān kěn dìng yǒu wù huì
ex.en: There must be some misunderstanding between us.

ex.zh: 行与行之间多留些空间。
ex.p: xíng yú xíng zhī jiān duō liú xiē kōng jiān
ex.en: Leave more space between the lines.

ex.zh: “我也那样觉得。”她附和道。
ex.p: wǒ yě nà yàng jué de tā fù hè dào
ex.en: "I think so, too," she chimed in.

ex.zh: 他不知道如何用英语写信。
ex.p: tā bù zhī dào rú hé yòng yīng yǔ xiě xìn
ex.en: He doesn't know how to write a letter in English.

ex.zh: 他甚至没说再见就离开了家。
ex.p: tā shèn zhì méi shuō zài jiàn jiù lí kāi le jiā
ex.en: He left the house without so much as saying goodbye.

ex.zh: 我甚至不想试试。
ex.p: wǒ shèn zhì bù xiǎng shì shì
ex.en: I don't even want to try it.

ex.zh: 你必须在两点半之前完成它。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū zài liǎng diǎn bàn zhī qián wán chéng tā
ex.en: You must finish this by 2:30.

ex.zh: 关于那件事你之前怎么想的？
ex.p: guān yú nà jiàn shì nǐ zhī qián zěn me xiǎng de
ex.en: How did you feel about that?

items.en: to be capable of; to be able to; can

ex.zh: 他努力学习，为的是能够考上大学。
ex.p: tā nǔ lì xué xí wèi de shì néng gòu kǎo shǎng dà xué
ex.en: He studied hard in order to get into college.

ex.zh: 你能够说出一首他们的歌的名字吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng gòu shuō chū yī shǒu tā men de gē de míng zi ma
ex.en: Can you name one of their songs?

ex.zh: 我再也无法相信任何人了。
ex.p: wǒ zài yě wú fǎ xiāng xìn rèn hé rén le
ex.en: I can't believe anyone anymore.

ex.zh: 没有你我无法做到，谢谢。
ex.p: méi yǒu nǐ wǒ wú fǎ zuò dào xiè xie
ex.en: I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.

items.en: to pull; to play (a bowed instrument); to drag

ex.zh: 请问您要多来点儿沙拉吗？
ex.p: qǐng wèn nín yào duō lái diǎn ér shā lā ma
ex.en: Would you like a little more salad?

ex.zh: 您听见我儿子拉小提琴了吗？
ex.p: nín tīng jiàn wǒ ér zi lā xiǎo tí qín le ma
ex.en: Did you hear my son play the violin?

items.en: regarding; as far as (sth) is concerned; with regard to

ex.zh: 为什么你对于这个有这样的想法？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ duì yú zhè gè yǒu zhè yàng de xiǎng fǎ
ex.en: Why should you think that?

ex.zh: 对于我，我不反对。
ex.p: duì yú wǒ wǒ bù fǎn duì
ex.en: As for me, I have no objection.

items.en: to be certain; to be positive; assuredly

ex.zh: 她可能是护士。我不太肯定。
ex.p: tā kě néng shì hù shi wǒ bù tài kěn dìng
ex.en: She may be a nurse. I am not sure.

ex.zh: 我肯定她很快就会回来的。
ex.p: wǒ kěn dìng tā hěn kuài jiù huì huí lai de
ex.en: I'm sure that she will come back soon.

items.en: (after a verb or adjective) one who (is) ...

ex.zh: 这本小说的作者是谁？
ex.p: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de zuò zhě shì shéi
ex.en: Who's the author of this story?

ex.zh: 我跟英语母语者学了四年英语。
ex.p: wǒ gēn yīng yǔ mǔ yǔ zhě xué le sì nián yīng yǔ
ex.en: I studied English for four years with a native speaker.

ex.zh: 我当时是高中生。
ex.p: wǒ dāng shí shì gāo zhōng shēng
ex.en: I was a high school student at that time.

ex.zh: 如果他当时再努力一点，他就成功了。
ex.p: rú guǒ tā dāng shí zài nǔ lì yī diǎn tā jiù chéng gōng le
ex.en: With a little more effort, he would have succeeded.

ex.zh: 在第一个信号灯处右转。
ex.p: zài dì yī gè xìn hào dēng chù yòu zhuǎi
ex.en: Turn right at the first traffic light.

ex.zh: 请在下一个十字路口右转。
ex.p: qǐng zài xià yī gè shí zì lù kǒu yòu zhuǎi
ex.en: Turn right at the next intersection.

ex.zh: 调查下这个。
ex.p: diào chá xià zhè gè
ex.en: Examine this.

ex.zh: 警察会调查这起案件。
ex.p: jǐng chá huì diào chá zhè qǐ àn jiàn
ex.en: The police will look into the case.

ex.zh: 我同意你一部分的意见。
ex.p: wǒ tóng yì nǐ yī bù fen de yì jiàn
ex.en: I agree with some of your opinions.

ex.zh: 我昨天大部分时间在家。
ex.p: wǒ zuó tiān dà bù fen shí jiān zài jiā
ex.en: I was at home most of the day yesterday.

ex.zh: 他适应了新的生活方式。
ex.p: tā shì yìng le xīn de shēng huó fāng shì
ex.en: He got accustomed to the new way of living.

ex.zh: 她不喜欢我说话的方式。
ex.p: tā bù xǐ huan wǒ shuō huà de fāng shì
ex.en: She doesn't like the way I speak.

ex.zh: 他强调都市生活的便利方面。
ex.p: tā qiáng diào dū shì shēng huó de biàn lì fāng miàn
ex.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.

ex.zh: 我想特别强调这一点。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng tè bié qiáng diào zhè yī diǎn
ex.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

ex.zh: 他有能力比我做得更好。
ex.p: tā yǒu néng lì bǐ wǒ zuò de gēng hǎo
ex.en: He can do it better than I can.

ex.zh: 他没能力做这个工作。
ex.p: tā méi néng lì zuò zhè gè gōng zuò
ex.en: He will not be able to do the work.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第47单元

Relationships and emotions

Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 你做了一项完美的工作。
sents.p: nǐ zuò le yī xiàng wán měi de gōng zuò
sents.en: You've done a perfect job.

sents.zh: 有很多美国人会说日语。
sents.p: yǒu hěn duō měi guó rén huì shuō rì yǔ
sents.en: There are many Americans who can speak Japanese.

sents.zh: 我必须通过这场考试。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū tōng guò zhè cháng kǎo shì
sents.en: I have to pass this exam.

sents.zh: 我不想不通过考试。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng bù tōng guò kǎo shì
sents.en: I don't want to fail my exams.

sents.zh: 他们的计划我一无所知。
sents.p: tā men de jì huà wǒ yī wú suǒ zhī
sents.en: I am quite ignorant of their plan.

sents.zh: 她无所事事地看向窗外
sents.p: tā wú suǒ shì shì de kàn xiàng chuāng wài
sents.en: She was idly looking out of the window.

sents.zh: 这是你所能做的一切了。
sents.p: zhè shì nǐ suǒ néng zuò de yī qiè le
sents.en: It's all you can really do.

sents.zh: 重力将一切带下地球表面。
sents.p: zhòng lì jiāng yī qiè dài xià dì qiú biǎo miàn
sents.en: Gravity brings everything down to Earth.

sents.zh: 从现在开始，由她来照顾你。
sents.p: cóng xiàn zài kāi shǐ yóu tā lái zhào gu nǐ
sents.en: She will care for you from now on.

sents.zh: 她有三个孩子，信不信由你。
sents.p: tā yǒu sān gè hái zi xìn bù xìn yóu nǐ
sents.en: Believe it or not, she has three children.

sents.zh: 他这么做，没有任何不安。
sents.p: tā zhè me zuò méi yǒu rèn hé bù ān
sents.en: He had no qualms in doing so.

sents.zh: 你可以做任何你想做的事。
sents.p: nǐ kě yǐ zuò rèn hé nǐ xiǎng zuò de shì
sents.en: You can do whatever you want to.

sents.zh: 他来还是不来，结果是一样的。
sents.p: tā lái hái shi bù lái jiē guǒ shì yī yàng de
sents.en: Whether he comes or not, the result will be the same.

sents.zh: 他们对结果很满意。
sents.p: tā men duì jiē guǒ hěn mǎn yì
sents.en: They are happy with the result.

sents.zh: 你觉得对此该做什么？
sents.p: nǐ jué de duì cǐ gāi zuò shén me
sents.en: What do you think should be done about it?

sents.zh: 早知如此，就不应该借钱给他。
sents.p: zǎo zhī rú cǐ jiù bù yīng gāi jiè qián gěi tā
sents.en: You should have known better than to lend him money.

sents.zh: 这人讲的我完全听不懂。
sents.p: zhè rén jiǎng de wǒ wán quán yǐn bù dǒng
sents.en: What he said was over my head.

sents.zh: 我们完全没有共同点。
sents.p: wǒ men wán quán méi yǒu gòng tóng diǎn
sents.en: We have absolutely nothing in common.

sents.zh: 他使他儿子成了个有钱人。
sents.p: tā shǐ tā ér zi chéng le gè yǒu qián rén
sents.en: He made his son a wealthy man.

sents.zh: 你们该养成使用字典的习惯。
sents.p: nǐ men gāi yǎng chéng shǐ yòng zì diǎn de xí guàn
sents.en: You should try to form the habit of using your dictionaries.

sents.zh: 我们在这里应该是安全的。
sents.p: wǒ men zài zhè lǐ yīng gāi shì ān quán de
sents.en: We should be safe here.

sents.zh: 你和我在这里很安全。
sents.p: nǐ hé wǒ zài zhè lǐ hěn ān quán
sents.en: You're safe here with me.

sents.zh: 我们队从来就没赢过。
sents.p: wǒ men duì cóng lái jiù méi yíng guò
sents.en: My team is always losing.

sents.zh: 我们要你做队长。
sents.p: wǒ men yào nǐ zuò duì zhǎng
sents.en: We want you to be the team captain.

sents.zh: 他们是从法国南部来的。
sents.p: tā men shì cóng fǎ guó nán bù lái de
sents.en: They come from the south of France.

sents.zh: 他的故事一部分是真的。
sents.p: tā de gù shì yī bù fen shì zhēn de
sents.en: Part of his story is true.

sents.zh: 他的失败看来有几个原因。
sents.p: tā de shī bài kàn lai yǒu jī gè yuán yīn
sents.en: There seem to be several reasons for his failure.

sents.zh: 我知道你不想去的真实原因。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào nǐ bù xiǎng qù de zhēn shí yuán yīn
sents.en: I know the real reason you don't want to go.

sents.zh: 我只是听到了一些消息。
sents.p: wǒ zhǐ shì tīng dào le yī xiē xiāo xi
sents.en: I just heard something.

sents.zh: 我有一些非常好的消息。
sents.p: wǒ yǒu yī xiē fēi cháng hǎo de xiāo xi
sents.en: I have some very good news.

sents.zh: 有时候成人表现得像儿童。
sents.p: yǒu shí hou chéng rén biǎo xiàn de xiàng ér tóng
sents.en: Sometimes adults behave like children.

sents.zh: 他不接受我的道歉。
sents.p: tā bù jiē shòu wǒ de dào qiàn
sents.en: He did not accept my apologies.

sents.zh: 他接受了她的礼物。
sents.p: tā jiē shòu le tā de lǐ wù
sents.en: He accepted her gift.

sents.zh: 其中一个学生今天没来。
sents.p: qí zhōng yī gè xué sheng jīn tiān méi lái
sents.en: One of the students didn't come today.

sents.zh: 我的其中一个行李不见了。
sents.p: wǒ de qí zhōng yī gè xíng li bù jiàn le
sents.en: One of my suitcases is missing.

sents.zh: 我很高兴知道你成功了。
sents.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng zhī dào nǐ chéng gōng le
sents.en: I was glad to hear of your success.

sents.zh: 我成功地得到了我想要的。
sents.p: wǒ chéng gōng de dé dào le wǒ xiǎng yào de
sents.en: I succeeded in getting what I wanted.

sents.zh: 我们之间肯定有误会。
sents.p: wǒ men zhī jiān kěn dìng yǒu wù huì
sents.en: There must be some misunderstanding between us.

sents.zh: 行与行之间多留些空间。
sents.p: xíng yú xíng zhī jiān duō liú xiē kōng jiān
sents.en: Leave more space between the lines.

sents.zh: “我也那样觉得。”她附和道。
sents.p: wǒ yě nà yàng jué de tā fù hè dào
sents.en: "I think so, too," she chimed in.

sents.zh: 他不知道如何用英语写信。
sents.p: tā bù zhī dào rú hé yòng yīng yǔ xiě xìn
sents.en: He doesn't know how to write a letter in English.

sents.zh: 他甚至没说再见就离开了家。
sents.p: tā shèn zhì méi shuō zài jiàn jiù lí kāi le jiā
sents.en: He left the house without so much as saying goodbye.

sents.zh: 我甚至不想试试。
sents.p: wǒ shèn zhì bù xiǎng shì shì
sents.en: I don't even want to try it.

sents.zh: 你必须在两点半之前完成它。
sents.p: nǐ bì xū zài liǎng diǎn bàn zhī qián wán chéng tā
sents.en: You must finish this by 2:30.

sents.zh: 关于那件事你之前怎么想的？
sents.p: guān yú nà jiàn shì nǐ zhī qián zěn me xiǎng de
sents.en: How did you feel about that?

sents.zh: 他努力学习，为的是能够考上大学。
sents.p: tā nǔ lì xué xí wèi de shì néng gòu kǎo shǎng dà xué
sents.en: He studied hard in order to get into college.

sents.zh: 你能够说出一首他们的歌的名字吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng gòu shuō chū yī shǒu tā men de gē de míng zi ma
sents.en: Can you name one of their songs?

sents.zh: 我再也无法相信任何人了。
sents.p: wǒ zài yě wú fǎ xiāng xìn rèn hé rén le
sents.en: I can't believe anyone anymore.

sents.zh: 没有你我无法做到，谢谢。
sents.p: méi yǒu nǐ wǒ wú fǎ zuò dào xiè xie
sents.en: I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.

sents.zh: 请问您要多来点儿沙拉吗？
sents.p: qǐng wèn nín yào duō lái diǎn ér shā lā ma
sents.en: Would you like a little more salad?

sents.zh: 您听见我儿子拉小提琴了吗？
sents.p: nín tīng jiàn wǒ ér zi lā xiǎo tí qín le ma
sents.en: Did you hear my son play the violin?

sents.zh: 为什么你对于这个有这样的想法？
sents.p: wèi shén me nǐ duì yú zhè gè yǒu zhè yàng de xiǎng fǎ
sents.en: Why should you think that?

sents.zh: 对于我，我不反对。
sents.p: duì yú wǒ wǒ bù fǎn duì
sents.en: As for me, I have no objection.

sents.zh: 她可能是护士。我不太肯定。
sents.p: tā kě néng shì hù shi wǒ bù tài kěn dìng
sents.en: She may be a nurse. I am not sure.

sents.zh: 我肯定她很快就会回来的。
sents.p: wǒ kěn dìng tā hěn kuài jiù huì huí lai de
sents.en: I'm sure that she will come back soon.

sents.zh: 这本小说的作者是谁？
sents.p: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de zuò zhě shì shéi
sents.en: Who's the author of this story?

sents.zh: 我跟英语母语者学了四年英语。
sents.p: wǒ gēn yīng yǔ mǔ yǔ zhě xué le sì nián yīng yǔ
sents.en: I studied English for four years with a native speaker.

sents.zh: 我当时是高中生。
sents.p: wǒ dāng shí shì gāo zhōng shēng
sents.en: I was a high school student at that time.

sents.zh: 如果他当时再努力一点，他就成功了。
sents.p: rú guǒ tā dāng shí zài nǔ lì yī diǎn tā jiù chéng gōng le
sents.en: With a little more effort, he would have succeeded.

sents.zh: 在第一个信号灯处右转。
sents.p: zài dì yī gè xìn hào dēng chù yòu zhuǎi
sents.en: Turn right at the first traffic light.

sents.zh: 请在下一个十字路口右转。
sents.p: qǐng zài xià yī gè shí zì lù kǒu yòu zhuǎi
sents.en: Turn right at the next intersection.

sents.zh: 调查下这个。
sents.p: diào chá xià zhè gè
sents.en: Examine this.

sents.zh: 警察会调查这起案件。
sents.p: jǐng chá huì diào chá zhè qǐ àn jiàn
sents.en: The police will look into the case.

sents.zh: 我同意你一部分的意见。
sents.p: wǒ tóng yì nǐ yī bù fen de yì jiàn
sents.en: I agree with some of your opinions.

sents.zh: 我昨天大部分时间在家。
sents.p: wǒ zuó tiān dà bù fen shí jiān zài jiā
sents.en: I was at home most of the day yesterday.

sents.zh: 他适应了新的生活方式。
sents.p: tā shì yìng le xīn de shēng huó fāng shì
sents.en: He got accustomed to the new way of living.

sents.zh: 她不喜欢我说话的方式。
sents.p: tā bù xǐ huan wǒ shuō huà de fāng shì
sents.en: She doesn't like the way I speak.

sents.zh: 他强调都市生活的便利方面。
sents.p: tā qiáng diào dū shì shēng huó de biàn lì fāng miàn
sents.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.

sents.zh: 我想特别强调这一点。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng tè bié qiáng diào zhè yī diǎn
sents.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

sents.zh: 他有能力比我做得更好。
sents.p: tā yǒu néng lì bǐ wǒ zuò de gēng hǎo
sents.en: He can do it better than I can.

sents.zh: 他没能力做这个工作。
sents.p: tā méi néng lì zuò zhè gè gōng zuò
sents.en: He will not be able to do the work.

units.title: Relationships and emotions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

items.en: to protect; to defend; to safeguard

ex.zh: 他认为他不需要他们的保护。
ex.p: tā rèn wéi tā bù xū yào tā men de bǎo hù
ex.en: He did not think he needed their protection.

ex.zh: 你没有保护我。
ex.p: nǐ méi yǒu bǎo hù wǒ
ex.en: You didn't protect me.

ex.zh: 一个是新的，另一个是旧的。
ex.p: yī gè shì xīn de lìng yī gè shì jiù de
ex.en: One's new. The other's old.

ex.zh: 她的房子在河的另一边。
ex.p: tā de fáng zi zài hé de lìng yī biān
ex.en: Her house is across the river.

ex.zh: 可那不是真正的问题所在。
ex.p: kě nà bù shì zhēn zhèng de wèn tí suǒ zài
ex.en: But that's not the real problem.

ex.zh: 你真正的目标是什么？
ex.p: nǐ zhēn zhèng de mù biāo shì shén me
ex.en: What's your real goal?

ex.zh: 我不能再管这问题了。
ex.p: wǒ bù néng zài guǎn zhè wèn tí le
ex.en: I can't deal with this problem anymore.

ex.zh: 我在油管上看它。
ex.p: wǒ zài yóu guǎn shǎng kàn tā
ex.en: I watched it on YouTube.

items.en: to be in favor of; to support; to back

ex.zh: 我全心全意地支持你。
ex.p: wǒ quán xīn quán yì de zhī chí nǐ
ex.en: I support you whole-heartedly.

ex.zh: 我不知道别人如何，但就我而论，我支持。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào bié ren rú hé dàn jiù wǒ ér lùn wǒ zhī chí
ex.en: I don't know about the others, but as for me, I'm for it.

items.en: to fall; to drop; to lag behind

ex.zh: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。
ex.p: kàn wán zhè fēng xìn qǐng bǎ tā shāo diào
ex.en: Burn this letter after you finish reading it.

ex.zh: 你的眼镜掉在地上了。
ex.p: nǐ de yǎn jìng diào zài dì shang le
ex.en: Your glasses fell on the floor.

items.en: to change; to alter; to transform

ex.zh: 让我知道我是否需要改变。
ex.p: ràng wǒ zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu xū yào gǎi biàn
ex.en: Let me know if I need to change.

ex.zh: 这样的话，我会改变主意。
ex.p: zhè yàng de huà wǒ huì gǎi biàn zhǔ yi
ex.en: In that case, I'll change my mind.

items.en: whether (or not); if; is or isn't

ex.zh: 我不知道我是否有时间做。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu yǒu shí jiān zuò
ex.en: I don't know if I have time to do it.

ex.zh: 谁也不知道他是否爱她。
ex.p: shéi yě bù zhī dào tā shì fǒu ài tā
ex.en: No one knows if he loves her or not.

ex.zh: 我已经活了大半辈子了。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng huó le dà bàn bèi zǐ le
ex.en: I've already lived most of my life.

ex.zh: 生活并不总是如我们所愿。
ex.p: shēng huó bìng bù zǒng shì rú wǒ men suǒ yuàn
ex.en: Life doesn't always go the way we want it to.

items.en: to be born; to give birth; life

ex.zh: 上天会帮助自力更生的人。
ex.p: shǎng tiān huì bāng zhù zì lì gēng shēng de rén
ex.en: God helps those who help themselves.

ex.zh: 今天是我一个朋友的生日。
ex.p: jīn tiān shì wǒ yī gè péng you de shēng rì
ex.en: Today is one of my friends' birthday.

ex.zh: 为什么你要烧这些图片呢？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ yào shāo zhè xiē tú piàn ne
ex.en: Why are you burning these pictures?

ex.zh: 你见过这张照片上的男人吗？
ex.p: nǐ jiàn guò zhè zhāng zhào piàn shǎng de nán rén ma
ex.en: Have you ever seen the man in this photo?

ex.zh: “我该做什么呢？”我自言自语道。
ex.p: wǒ gāi zuò shén me ne wǒ zì yán zì yǔ dào
ex.en: "What should I do?" I said to myself.

ex.zh: 他的自行车是蓝色的。
ex.p: tā de zì xíng chē shì lán sè de
ex.en: His bicycle is blue.

items.en: to pat; to clap; to slap

ex.zh: 抱歉，这是我的球拍。
ex.p: bào qiàn zhè shì wǒ de qiú pāi
ex.en: Pardon me, but that's my racket.

ex.zh: 她用力地拍了球。
ex.p: tā yòng lì de pāi le qiú
ex.en: She hit the ball hard.

ex.zh: 他把整个苹果都吃了。
ex.p: tā bǎ zhěng gè píng guǒ dōu chī le
ex.en: He ate the whole apple.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第48单元

Relationships and emotions

Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.en: But that's not the real problem.

sents.p: nǐ zhēn zhèng de mù biāo shì shén me
sents.en: What's your real goal?

sents.p: wǒ bù néng zài guǎn zhè wèn tí le

sents.p: wǒ zài yóu guǎn shǎng kàn tā

sents.en: I don't know about the others, but as for me, I'm for it.

sents.zh: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。

sents.en: Burn this letter after you finish reading it.

sents.p: nǐ de yǎn jìng diào zài dì shang le

sents.p: ràng wǒ zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu xū yào gǎi biàn
sents.en: Let me know if I need to change.

sents.zh: 这样的话，我会改变主意。
sents.p: zhè yàng de huà wǒ huì gǎi biàn zhǔ yi
sents.en: In that case, I'll change my mind.

sents.zh: 我不知道我是否有时间做。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu yǒu shí jiān zuò
sents.en: I don't know if I have time to do it.

sents.zh: 谁也不知道他是否爱她。
sents.p: shéi yě bù zhī dào tā shì fǒu ài tā
sents.en: No one knows if he loves her or not.

sents.zh: 我已经活了大半辈子了。
sents.p: wǒ yǐ jīng huó le dà bàn bèi zǐ le
sents.en: I've already lived most of my life.

sents.p: shēng huó bìng bù zǒng shì rú wǒ men suǒ yuàn
sents.en: Life doesn't always go the way we want it to.

sents.en: God helps those who help themselves.

sents.en: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.

sents.zh: 我不知道如何使用它。

sents.en: I don't know how to use it.

sents.zh: 你知道怎么使用吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me shǐ yòng ma
sents.en: Do you know how to use this?

sents.zh: 日本的首都是东京。
sents.p: rì běn de shǒu dū shì dōng jīng

sents.zh: 我们到了就打电话跟您联系。
sents.p: wǒ men dào le jiù dǎ diàn huà gēn nín lián xì

sents.zh: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。
sents.p: wǒ men lián xì shǎng tā men yǐ jīng wèi shí yǐ wǎn

sents.zh: 他按照字面上的意思。
sents.p: tā àn zhào zì miàn shǎng de yì si
sents.en: He took it literally.

sents.zh: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。
sents.p: lǎo shī àn zhào shēn gāo gěi hái zi men pái duì
sents.en: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.

ex.zh: 你无法证明。
ex.p: nǐ wú fǎ zhèng míng
ex.en: You can't prove that.

ex.en: Are you a reporter?

sents.p: lái hǎo hǎo lì yòng dà zhōu mò ba
sents.en: Let's take advantage of the long weekend.

sents.zh: 他在入学考试中失败了。
sents.p: tā zài rù xué kǎo shì zhōng shī bài le
sents.en: He failed the entrance exam.

sents.zh: 他忙着准备入学考试。
sents.p: tā máng zhe zhǔn bèi rù xué kǎo shì
sents.en: He is busy preparing for the entrance examination.

sents.zh: 就在那时，公交车停住了。
sents.p: jiù zài nà shí gōng jiāo chē tíng zhù le
sents.en: Just then, the bus stopped.

sents.zh: 我听到一辆车停了下来。
sents.p: wǒ tīng dào yī liàng chē tíng le xià lai
sents.en: I heard a car pull up.

sents.zh: 你为什么对我这么小气？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me duì wǒ zhè me xiǎo qì
sents.en: Why are you so mean to me?

sents.zh: 好天气能持续到明天吗？
sents.p: hǎo tiān qì néng chí xù dào míng tiān ma
sents.en: Will the fine weather keep up till tomorrow?

sents.zh: 事故差点让他丢了性命。
sents.p: shì gù chà diǎn ràng tā diū le xìng mìng
sents.en: The accident almost cost him his life.

sents.zh: 他强调了教育的重要性。
sents.p: tā qiáng diào le jiào yù de zhòng yào xìng
sents.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.

sents.zh: 她倒很可爱，但我不喜欢她。
sents.p: tā dào hěn kě ài dàn wǒ bù xǐ huan tā
sents.en: She may be cute, but I don't like her.

sents.zh: 她总是在班上拿倒数第一。
sents.p: tā zǒng shì zài bān shǎng ná dào shǔ dì yī
sents.en: She is always at the bottom of the class.

sents.zh: 你一定要注意他的建议。
sents.p: nǐ yī dìng yào zhù yì tā de jiàn yì
sents.en: You must pay attention to his advice.

sents.zh: 你最好照着医生的建议做。
sents.p: nǐ zuì hǎo zhào zhe yī shēng de jiàn yì zuò
sents.en: You'd better do as the doctor advised you.

sents.zh: 这个问题有多严重？
sents.p: zhè gè wèn tí yǒu duō yán zhòng
sents.en: How serious is the problem?

sents.zh: 这是很严重的病。
sents.p: zhè shì hěn yán zhòng de bìng
sents.en: It's a very serious illness.

sents.zh: 你儿子正在和我女儿约会。
sents.p: nǐ ér zi zhèng zài hé wǒ nǚ ér yuē huì
sents.en: Your son is dating my daughter.

sents.zh: 很抱歉，我还有另一个约会。
sents.p: hěn bào qiàn wǒ hái yǒu lìng yī gè yuē huì
sents.en: I'm sorry. I have another appointment.

sents.zh: 我看见远处有灯光。
sents.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yuǎn chù yǒu dēng guāng
sents.en: I saw a light in the distance.

sents.zh: 拍照片光线不够亮。
sents.p: pāi zhào piān guāng xiàn bù gòu liàng
sents.en: There is insufficient light to take pictures.

sents.zh: 法律有很多不明确的地方。
sents.p: fǎ lǜ yǒu hěn duō bù míng què de dì fāng
sents.en: The law is full of ambiguities.

sents.zh: 法律之前人人平等。
sents.p: fǎ lǜ zhī qián rén rén píng děng
sents.en: All men are equal under the law.

sents.zh: 他接手了他父亲的公司。
sents.p: tā jiē shǒu le tā fù qīn de gōng sī
sents.en: He has taken over his father's business.

sents.zh: 她父亲在她三岁时死了。
sents.p: tā fù qīn zài tā sān suì shí sǐ le
sents.en: Her father died when she was three.

sents.zh: 你的项目进展得怎么样？
sents.p: nǐ de xiàng mù jìn zhǎn de zěn me yàng
sents.en: How's your project going?

sents.zh: 他们一起为这个项目工作过。
sents.p: tā men yī qǐ wèi zhè gè xiàng mù gōng zuò guò
sents.en: They worked jointly on this project.

sents.zh: 我会给你证明的。
sents.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ zhèng míng de
sents.en: I'll prove it to you.

sents.zh: 你无法证明。
sents.p: nǐ wú fǎ zhèng míng
sents.en: You can't prove that.

sents.zh: 我想成为记者。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng chéng wéi jì zhě
sents.en: I want to be a journalist.

sents.zh: 你是记者吗？
sents.p: nǐ shì jì zhě ma
sents.en: Are you a reporter?

sents.zh: 你到底在我房间里干什么？
sents.p: nǐ dào dǐ zài wǒ fáng jiān lǐ gàn shén me
sents.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?

sents.zh: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。
sents.p: tā men de hé tong zài zhè gè yuè dǐ dào qī
sents.en: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.

sents.zh: 我确实在这里丢了东西。
sents.p: wǒ què shí zài zhè lǐ diū le dōng xī
sents.en: I'm clearly missing something here.

sents.zh: 我确实喜欢我的同事。
sents.p: wǒ què shí xǐ huan wǒ de tóng shì
sents.en: I really like my coworkers.

units.title: Relationships and emotions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

items.en: to count; to count as; to regard as; to enumerate; to list

ex.zh: 多数人每天至少刷两次牙。
ex.p: duō shù rén měi tiān zhì shǎo shuā liǎng cì yá
ex.en: Most people brush their teeth at least two times a day.

ex.zh: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。
ex.p: tā dé dào le bǐ wǒ men hái gāo de fēn shù
ex.en: He got a better score than us.

items.en: to express; to show; to say

ex.zh: 他们像老朋友一样交谈。
ex.p: tā men xiàng lǎo péng you yī yàng jiāo tán
ex.en: They talked together like old friends.

ex.zh: 他们谈计划谈了几个小时。
ex.p: tā men tán jì huà tán le jī gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: They talked over the plan for hours.

ex.zh: 我们每天至少该睡八小时。
ex.p: wǒ men měi tiān zhì shǎo gāi shuì bā xiǎo shí
ex.en: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.

ex.zh: 我们班至少有三十个学生。
ex.p: wǒ men bān zhì shǎo yǒu sān shí gè xué sheng
ex.en: There are at least thirty students in our class.

ex.zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。
ex.p: tā jiě shì le jù zi de zì miàn yì si
ex.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentence.

ex.zh: 他解释事故是怎么发生的。
ex.p: tā jiě shì shì gù shì zěn me fā shēng de
ex.en: He explained how the accident came about.

items.en: to be in charge of; to take responsibility for; to be to blame

ex.zh: 一个人要为他的行为负责。
ex.p: yī gè rén yào wèi tā de xíng wéi fù zé
ex.en: A man is responsible for his deeds.

ex.zh: 我为这个错误负责。
ex.p: wǒ wèi zhè gè cuò wù fù zé
ex.en: I'm responsible for the mistake.

items.en: first (of all); in the first place

ex.zh: 法语说得快，我就难以理解。
ex.p: fǎ yǔ shuō de kuài wǒ jiù nán yǐ lǐ jiě
ex.en: It's hard for me to understand French when it's spoken quickly.

ex.zh: 我理解你所说的一切。
ex.p: wǒ lǐ jiě nǐ suǒ shuō de yī qiè
ex.en: I understand everything you said.

ex.zh: 他们并不总是服从父母。
ex.p: tā men bìng bù zǒng shì fú cóng fù mǔ
ex.en: They don't always obey their parents.

ex.zh: 他八岁时离开了他的父母。
ex.p: tā bā suì shí lí kāi le tā de fù mǔ
ex.en: He left his parents when he was eight years old.

ex.zh: 你的学校在这个城市吗？
ex.p: nǐ de xué xiào zài zhè gè chéng shì ma
ex.en: Is your school in this town?

ex.zh: 在这个城市，很难打到的。
ex.p: zài zhè gè chéng shì hěn nán dá dào de
ex.en: It's very hard getting a taxi in this city.

ex.zh: 教育的最终目的是什么？
ex.p: jiào yù de zuì zhōng mù dì shì shén me
ex.en: What is the ultimate purpose of education?

ex.zh: 我最终得到了我要的那本书。
ex.p: wǒ zuì zhōng dé dào le wǒ yào de nà běn shū
ex.en: I finally got hold of that book I wanted.

items.en: to arrange; to plan; to set up

ex.zh: 明天你有什么安排没有？
ex.p: míng tiān nǐ yǒu shén me ān pái méi yǒu
ex.en: Do you have any plans for tomorrow?

ex.zh: 我们很快就可以安排您入座。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn kuài jiù kě yǐ ān pái nín rù zuò
ex.en: We can seat you soon.

items.en: to dare; daring; (polite) may I venture

ex.zh: 你怎么敢这样跟我说话！
ex.p: nǐ zěn me gǎn zhè yàng gēn wǒ shuō huà
ex.en: How dare you speak to me like that!

ex.zh: 我不敢对他说这种话。
ex.p: wǒ bù gǎn duì tā shuō zhè zhǒng huà
ex.en: I don't dare tell him such a thing.

ex.zh: 她梦见她是一个公主。
ex.p: tā mèng jiàn tā shì yī gè gōng zhǔ
ex.en: She dreamed that she was a princess.

ex.zh: 我做了一个奇怪的梦。
ex.p: wǒ zuò le yī gè qí guài de mèng
ex.en: I had a strange dream.

ex.zh: 请重新考虑一下。
ex.p: qǐng chóng xīn kǎo lǜ yī xià
ex.en: Please reconsider.

items.en: used in 防 and 溜

ex.zh: 你可以给我一个提示吗？
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ yī gè tí shì ma
ex.en: Would you give me a hint?

ex.zh: 她就那件事给他提出建议。
ex.p: tā jiù nà jiàn shì gěi tā tí chū jiàn yì
ex.en: She advised him on that matter.

ex.zh: 人生是不公平的，是吧？
ex.p: rén shēng shì bù gōng píng de shì ba
ex.en: Life isn't fair, is it?

ex.zh: 人人生来平等。
ex.p: rén rén shēng lái píng děng
ex.en: All men are created equal.

ex.zh: 你的头发自然发色是什么颜色？
ex.p: nǐ de tóu fa zì rán fā sè shì shén me yán sè
ex.en: What's your natural hair color?

ex.zh: 酸雨不是自然现象。
ex.p: suān yǔ bù shì zì rán xiàn xiàng
ex.en: Acid rain isn't a natural phenomenon.

ex.zh: 我完全不负任何责任。
ex.p: wǒ wán quán bù fù rèn hé zé rèn
ex.en: I don't take any responsibility at all.

ex.zh: 做那事是我的责任。
ex.p: zuò nà shì shì wǒ de zé rèn
ex.en: It was my duty to do that.

items.en: to feel; to move; to touch

ex.zh: 我们真的感激他们的努力。
ex.p: wǒ men zhēn de gǎn jī tā men de nǔ lì
ex.en: We really appreciate their effort.

ex.zh: 我回到家的时候，感觉非常饿。
ex.p: wǒ huí dào jiā de shí hou gǎn jué fēi cháng è
ex.en: When I got home, I was very hungry.

ex.zh: 我又失去了一次机会。
ex.p: wǒ yòu shī qù le yī cì jī huì
ex.en: I've missed another chance.

ex.zh: 我只是不想失去你。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ shì bù xiǎng shī qù nǐ
ex.en: I just don't want to lose you.

ex.zh: 他们正努力降低成本。
ex.p: tā men zhēng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn
ex.en: They're trying to keep costs down.

ex.zh: 你的国家的最低工资是多少？
ex.p: nǐ de guó jiā de zuì dī gōng zī shì duō shǎo
ex.en: What's the minimum wage in your country?

ex.zh: 我只想弄清楚发生了什么。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ xiǎng lòng qīng chu fā shēng le shén me
ex.en: I just want to find out what happened.

ex.zh: 你把你的铅笔弄掉了。
ex.p: nǐ bǎ nǐ de qiān bǐ lòng diào le
ex.en: You dropped your pencil.

items.en: to act on; to affect; action

ex.zh: 药物的作用还不确定。
ex.p: yào wù de zuò yòng hái bù què dìng
ex.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.

ex.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
ex.p: diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
ex.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.

ex.zh: 你会发现难以满足她。
ex.p: nǐ huì fā xiàn nán yǐ mǎn zú tā
ex.en: You'll find it difficult to meet her requirements.

ex.zh: 就我而言，我很满意。
ex.p: jiù wǒ ér yán wǒ hěn mǎn yì
ex.en: As for me, I'm satisfied.

items.en: to explain; to illustrate; to indicate

ex.zh: 这什么都说明不了！
ex.p: zhè shén me dōu shuō míng bù liǎo
ex.en: It doesn't mean anything.

ex.zh: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。
ex.p: hěn nán shuō míng tiān de tiān qì jiāng huì zěn yàng
ex.en: It's hard to say what the weather will be like tomorrow.

ex.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。
ex.p: xǔ duō rén zài gōng yè chéng shì gōng zuò
ex.en: Many people work in industrial towns.

ex.zh: 许多人夏天在这里游泳。
ex.p: xǔ duō rén xià tiān zài zhè lǐ yóu yǒng
ex.en: A lot of people swim here in the summer.

ex.zh: 请给我同样的东西。
ex.p: qǐng gěi wǒ tóng yàng de dōng xī
ex.en: Give me the same, please.

ex.zh: 我很确定你也会为我做同样的事。
ex.p: wǒ hěn què dìng nǐ yě huì wèi wǒ zuò tóng yàng de shì
ex.en: I'm sure you would do the same for me.

ex.zh: 我不知道下一步做什么。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào xià yī bù zuò shén me
ex.en: I don't know what the next step is.

ex.zh: 我们通常步行去学校。
ex.p: wǒ men tōng cháng bù xíng qù xué xiào
ex.en: We usually walk to school.

ex.zh: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。
ex.p: shì zhe yòng jī jí de tài du qù miàn duì rèn hé shì qing
ex.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.

ex.zh: 我最近压力有点大。
ex.p: wǒ zuì jìn yā lì yǒu diǎn dà
ex.en: I've been under a lot of pressure lately.

items.en: due to; as a result of; thanks to

ex.zh: 由于我生病了，我便没去上学。
ex.p: yóu yú wǒ shēng bìng le wǒ biàn méi qù shàng xué
ex.en: Since I was sick, I didn't go to school.

ex.zh: 由于下雨，我们没能上外头打网球。
ex.p: yóu yú xià yǔ wǒ men méi néng shǎng wài tou dá wǎng qiú
ex.en: The rain stopped us from being able to play tennis outside.

ex.zh: 他给我们看他母亲的照片。
ex.p: tā gěi wǒ men kàn tā mǔ qīn de zhào piàn
ex.en: He showed us his mother's picture.

ex.zh: 我会给我的母亲寄封信。
ex.p: wǒ huì gěi wǒ de mǔ qīn jì fēng xìn
ex.en: I'll send my mother a letter.

items.en: one more time; again; one more

ex.zh: 我们很高兴再次见到你。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng zài cì jiàn dào nǐ
ex.en: We are happy to see you again.

ex.zh: 他再次被选为市长。
ex.p: tā zài cì bèi xuǎn wèi shì zhǎng
ex.en: He was re-elected mayor.

ex.zh: 在我的部门里有七男四女。
ex.p: zài wǒ de bù mén lǐ yǒu qī nán sì nǚ
ex.en: There are seven men and four women in my section.

ex.zh: 谁负责这个部门？
ex.p: shéi fù zé zhè gè bù mén
ex.en: Who's in charge of this section?

items.en: to renounce; to abandon; to give up

ex.zh: 她不得不放弃这个计划。
ex.p: tā bù dé bù fàng qì zhè gè jì huà
ex.en: She was obliged to give up the plan.

ex.zh: 我说服他放弃了这个主意。
ex.p: wǒ shuō fú tā fàng qì le zhè gè zhǔ yi
ex.en: I talked him out of the idea.

ex.zh: 我无法同意你的意见。
ex.p: wǒ wú fǎ tóng yì nǐ de yì jiàn
ex.en: I can't agree with you.

ex.zh: 我需要你的意见。
ex.p: wǒ xū yào nǐ de yì jiàn
ex.en: I need your advice.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第50单元

Relationships and emotions

Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 多数人每天至少刷两次牙。
sents.p: duō shù rén měi tiān zhì shǎo shuā liǎng cì yá
sents.en: Most people brush their teeth at least two times a day.

sents.zh: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。
sents.p: tā dé dào le bǐ wǒ men hái gāo de fēn shù
sents.en: He got a better score than us.

sents.zh: 他们像老朋友一样交谈。
sents.p: tā men xiàng lǎo péng you yī yàng jiāo tán
sents.en: They talked together like old friends.

sents.zh: 他们谈计划谈了几个小时。
sents.p: tā men tán jì huà tán le jī gè xiǎo shí
sents.en: They talked over the plan for hours.

sents.zh: 我们每天至少该睡八小时。
sents.p: wǒ men měi tiān zhì shǎo gāi shuì bā xiǎo shí
sents.en: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.

sents.zh: 我们班至少有三十个学生。
sents.p: wǒ men bān zhì shǎo yǒu sān shí gè xué sheng
sents.en: There are at least thirty students in our class.

sents.zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。
sents.p: tā jiě shì le jù zi de zì miàn yì si
sents.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentence.

sents.zh: 他解释事故是怎么发生的。
sents.p: tā jiě shì shì gù shì zěn me fā shēng de
sents.en: He explained how the accident came about.

sents.zh: 一个人要为他的行为负责。
sents.p: yī gè rén yào wèi tā de xíng wéi fù zé
sents.en: A man is responsible for his deeds.

sents.zh: 我为这个错误负责。
sents.p: wǒ wèi zhè gè cuò wù fù zé
sents.en: I'm responsible for the mistake.

sents.zh: 法语说得快，我就难以理解。
sents.p: fǎ yǔ shuō de kuài wǒ jiù nán yǐ lǐ jiě
sents.en: It's hard for me to understand French when it's spoken quickly.

sents.zh: 我理解你所说的一切。
sents.p: wǒ lǐ jiě nǐ suǒ shuō de yī qiè
sents.en: I understand everything you said.

sents.zh: 他们并不总是服从父母。
sents.p: tā men bìng bù zǒng shì fú cóng fù mǔ
sents.en: They don't always obey their parents.

sents.zh: 他八岁时离开了他的父母。
sents.p: tā bā suì shí lí kāi le tā de fù mǔ
sents.en: He left his parents when he was eight years old.

sents.zh: 你的学校在这个城市吗？
sents.p: nǐ de xué xiào zài zhè gè chéng shì ma
sents.en: Is your school in this town?

sents.zh: 在这个城市，很难打到的。
sents.p: zài zhè gè chéng shì hěn nán dá dào de
sents.en: It's very hard getting a taxi in this city.

sents.zh: 教育的最终目的是什么？
sents.p: jiào yù de zuì zhōng mù dì shì shén me
sents.en: What is the ultimate purpose of education?

sents.zh: 我最终得到了我要的那本书。
sents.p: wǒ zuì zhōng dé dào le wǒ yào de nà běn shū
sents.en: I finally got hold of that book I wanted.

sents.zh: 明天你有什么安排没有？
sents.p: míng tiān nǐ yǒu shén me ān pái méi yǒu
sents.en: Do you have any plans for tomorrow?

sents.zh: 我们很快就可以安排您入座。
sents.p: wǒ men hěn kuài jiù kě yǐ ān pái nín rù zuò
sents.en: We can seat you soon.

sents.zh: 你怎么敢这样跟我说话！
sents.p: nǐ zěn me gǎn zhè yàng gēn wǒ shuō huà
sents.en: How dare you speak to me like that!

sents.zh: 我不敢对他说这种话。
sents.p: wǒ bù gǎn duì tā shuō zhè zhǒng huà
sents.en: I don't dare tell him such a thing.

sents.zh: 她梦见她是一个公主。
sents.p: tā mèng jiàn tā shì yī gè gōng zhǔ
sents.en: She dreamed that she was a princess.

sents.zh: 我做了一个奇怪的梦。
sents.p: wǒ zuò le yī gè qí guài de mèng
sents.en: I had a strange dream.

sents.zh: 请重新考虑一下。
sents.p: qǐng chóng xīn kǎo lǜ yī xià
sents.en: Please reconsider.

sents.zh: 你可以给我一个提示吗？
sents.p: nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ yī gè tí shì ma
sents.en: Would you give me a hint?

sents.zh: 她就那件事给他提出建议。
sents.p: tā jiù nà jiàn shì gěi tā tí chū jiàn yì
sents.en: She advised him on that matter.

sents.zh: 人生是不公平的，是吧？
sents.p: rén shēng shì bù gōng píng de shì ba
sents.en: Life isn't fair, is it?

sents.zh: 人人生来平等。
sents.p: rén rén shēng lái píng děng
sents.en: All men are created equal.

sents.zh: 你的头发自然发色是什么颜色？
sents.p: nǐ de tóu fa zì rán fā sè shì shén me yán sè
sents.en: What's your natural hair color?

sents.zh: 酸雨不是自然现象。
sents.p: suān yǔ bù shì zì rán xiàn xiàng
sents.en: Acid rain isn't a natural phenomenon.

sents.zh: 我完全不负任何责任。
sents.p: wǒ wán quán bù fù rèn hé zé rèn
sents.en: I don't take any responsibility at all.

sents.zh: 做那事是我的责任。
sents.p: zuò nà shì shì wǒ de zé rèn
sents.en: It was my duty to do that.

sents.zh: 我们真的感激他们的努力。
sents.p: wǒ men zhēn de gǎn jī tā men de nǔ lì
sents.en: We really appreciate their effort.

sents.zh: 我回到家的时候，感觉非常饿。
sents.p: wǒ huí dào jiā de shí hou gǎn jué fēi cháng è
sents.en: When I got home, I was very hungry.

sents.zh: 我又失去了一次机会。
sents.p: wǒ yòu shī qù le yī cì jī huì
sents.en: I've missed another chance.

sents.zh: 我只是不想失去你。
sents.p: wǒ zhǐ shì bù xiǎng shī qù nǐ
sents.en: I just don't want to lose you.

sents.zh: 他们正努力降低成本。
sents.p: tā men zhēng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn
sents.en: They're trying to keep costs down.

sents.zh: 你的国家的最低工资是多少？
sents.p: nǐ de guó jiā de zuì dī gōng zī shì duō shǎo
sents.en: What's the minimum wage in your country?

sents.zh: 我只想弄清楚发生了什么。
sents.p: wǒ zhǐ xiǎng lòng qīng chu fā shēng le shén me
sents.en: I just want to find out what happened.

sents.zh: 你把你的铅笔弄掉了。
sents.p: nǐ bǎ nǐ de qiān bǐ lòng diào le
sents.en: You dropped your pencil.

sents.zh: 药物的作用还不确定。
sents.p: yào wù de zuò yòng hái bù què dìng
sents.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.

sents.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
sents.p: diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
sents.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.

sents.zh: 你会发现难以满足她。
sents.p: nǐ huì fā xiàn nán yǐ mǎn zú tā
sents.en: You'll find it difficult to meet her requirements.

sents.zh: 就我而言，我很满意。
sents.p: jiù wǒ ér yán wǒ hěn mǎn yì
sents.en: As for me, I'm satisfied.

sents.zh: 这什么都说明不了！
sents.p: zhè shén me dōu shuō míng bù liǎo
sents.en: It doesn't mean anything.

sents.zh: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。
sents.p: hěn nán shuō míng tiān de tiān qì jiāng huì zěn yàng
sents.en: It's hard to say what the weather will be like tomorrow.

sents.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。
sents.p: xǔ duō rén zài gōng yè chéng shì gōng zuò
sents.en: Many people work in industrial towns.

sents.zh: 许多人夏天在这里游泳。
sents.p: xǔ duō rén xià tiān zài zhè lǐ yóu yǒng
sents.en: A lot of people swim here in the summer.

sents.zh: 请给我同样的东西。
sents.p: qǐng gěi wǒ tóng yàng de dōng xī
sents.en: Give me the same, please.

sents.zh: 我很确定你也会为我做同样的事。
sents.p: wǒ hěn què dìng nǐ yě huì wèi wǒ zuò tóng yàng de shì
sents.en: I'm sure you would do the same for me.

sents.zh: 我不知道下一步做什么。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào xià yī bù zuò shén me
sents.en: I don't know what the next step is.

sents.zh: 我们通常步行去学校。
sents.p: wǒ men tōng cháng bù xíng qù xué xiào
sents.en: We usually walk to school.

sents.zh: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。
sents.p: shì zhe yòng jī jí de tài du qù miàn duì rèn hé shì qing
sents.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.

sents.zh: 我最近压力有点大。
sents.p: wǒ zuì jìn yā lì yǒu diǎn dà
sents.en: I've been under a lot of pressure lately.

sents.zh: 由于我生病了，我便没去上学。
sents.p: yóu yú wǒ shēng bìng le wǒ biàn méi qù shàng xué
sents.en: Since I was sick, I didn't go to school.

sents.zh: 由于下雨，我们没能上外头打网球。
sents.p: yóu yú xià yǔ wǒ men méi néng shǎng wài tou dá wǎng qiú
sents.en: The rain stopped us from being able to play tennis outside.

sents.zh: 他给我们看他母亲的照片。
sents.p: tā gěi wǒ men kàn tā mǔ qīn de zhào piàn
sents.en: He showed us his mother's picture.

sents.zh: 我会给我的母亲寄封信。
sents.p: wǒ huì gěi wǒ de mǔ qīn jì fēng xìn
sents.en: I'll send my mother a letter.

sents.zh: 我们很高兴再次见到你。
sents.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng zài cì jiàn dào nǐ
sents.en: We are happy to see you again.

sents.zh: 他再次被选为市长。
sents.p: tā zài cì bèi xuǎn wèi shì zhǎng
sents.en: He was re-elected mayor.

sents.zh: 在我的部门里有七男四女。
sents.p: zài wǒ de bù mén lǐ yǒu qī nán sì nǚ
sents.en: There are seven men and four women in my section.

sents.zh: 谁负责这个部门？
sents.p: shéi fù zé zhè gè bù mén
sents.en: Who's in charge of this section?

sents.zh: 她不得不放弃这个计划。
sents.p: tā bù dé bù fàng qì zhè gè jì huà
sents.en: She was obliged to give up the plan.

sents.zh: 我说服他放弃了这个主意。
sents.p: wǒ shuō fú tā fàng qì le zhè gè zhǔ yi
sents.en: I talked him out of the idea.

sents.zh: 我无法同意你的意见。
sents.p: wǒ wú fǎ tóng yì nǐ de yì jiàn
sents.en: I can't agree with you.

sents.zh: 我需要你的意见。
sents.p: wǒ xū yào nǐ de yì jiàn
sents.en: I need your advice.

units.title: Work and careers
units.intro: Grammar focus: 对于; 通过; 按照; 由; writing a short email

ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，他还是出去了。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn xià zhe yǔ tā hái shi chū qù le
ex.en: He went out in spite of the rain.

ex.zh: 尽管天气很冷，孩子却没有大衣穿。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn tiān qì hěn lěng hái zi què méi yǒu dà yī chuān
ex.en: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.

ex.zh: 这个湖在这个地方很深。
ex.p: zhè gè hú zài zhè gè dì fāng hěn shēn
ex.en: The lake is deep here.

ex.zh: 他穿了一件深色毛衣。
ex.p: tā chuān le yī jiàn shēn sè máo yī
ex.en: He wore a dark sweater.

ex.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。
ex.p: wǒ men tán lùn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de huà tí
ex.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.

ex.zh: 他有各种各样的书。
ex.p: tā yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de shū
ex.en: He has all kinds of books.

ex.zh: 这个想法仍然在我心中。
ex.p: zhè gè xiǎng fǎ réng rán zài wǒ xīn zhōng
ex.en: The idea is still in my mind.

ex.zh: 他仍然时不时来看我。
ex.p: tā réng rán shí bù shí lái kàn wǒ
ex.en: He still comes to see me now and then.

items.en: second (unit of time); arc second (angular measurement unit); (coll.) instantly

ex.zh: 如果值得一做，就值得做好。
ex.p: rú guǒ zhí de yī zuò jiù zhí de zuò hǎo
ex.en: If it is worth doing at all, it is worth doing well.

ex.zh: 这本书值得再看一遍。
ex.p: zhè běn shū zhí de zài kàn yī biàn
ex.en: This book is worth reading again.

items.en: experience; to experience; to go through

ex.zh: 他有许多不愉快的经历。
ex.p: tā yǒu xǔ duō bù yú kuài de jīng lì
ex.en: He's had many unhappy experiences.

ex.zh: 我们在第三章讨论这个问题。
ex.p: wǒ men zài dì sān zhāng tǎo lùn zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: We'll deal with this problem in Chapter 3.

ex.zh: 我们来讨论下明天吧。
ex.p: wǒ men lái tǎo lùn xià míng tiān ba
ex.en: Let's talk about this tomorrow.

items.en: to surpass; to exceed; to outstrip

ex.zh: 他应该超过六十岁了。
ex.p: tā yīng gāi chāo guò liù shí suì le
ex.en: He must be over sixty.

ex.zh: 他有超过一百万美元的资产。
ex.p: tā yǒu chāo guò yī bǎi mò měi yuán de zī chǎn
ex.en: He has over a million dollars in assets.

items.en: still; yet; to remain; (literary) frequently; often

ex.zh: 我仍是这里的老板。
ex.p: wǒ réng shì zhè lǐ de lǎo bǎn
ex.en: I'm still the boss here.

ex.zh: 它仍可能会发生。
ex.p: tā réng kě néng huì fā shēng
ex.en: It still could happen.

ex.zh: “好人不长命”是句或真或假的老话。
ex.p: hǎo rén bù cháng mìng shì gōu huò zhēn huò jià de lǎo huà
ex.en: "The good die young" is an old saying which may or may not be true.

ex.zh: 他休了一周的假。
ex.p: tā xiū le yī zhōu de jià
ex.en: He took a week off.

items.en: to become a member; to join; to mix into

ex.zh: 我们很高兴你加入了我们班。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng nǐ jiā rù le wǒ men bān
ex.en: We are glad to have you in our class.

ex.zh: 不是所有国家都加入了联合国。
ex.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu guó jiā dōu jiā rù le lián hé guó
ex.en: Not every country belongs to the U.N.

items.en: brothers; younger brother; I, me (humble term used by men in public speech)

ex.zh: 他们错把他当成他的兄弟。
ex.p: tā men cuò bǎ tā dàng chéng tā de xiōng dì
ex.en: They mistook him for his brother.

ex.zh: 他有一个兄弟和两个姐妹。
ex.p: tā yǒu yī gè xiōng dì hé liǎng gè jiě mèi
ex.en: He has a brother and two sisters.

ex.zh: 我在信封上写错了地址。
ex.p: wǒ zài xìn fēng shǎng xiě cuò le dì zhǐ
ex.en: I wrote the wrong address on the envelope.

ex.zh: 我不知道他的地址。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā de dì zhǐ
ex.en: I don't know his address.

items.en: to change; to alter; to transform

ex.zh: 你的论文还需要改进。
ex.p: nǐ de lùn wén hái xū yào gǎi jìn
ex.en: Your essay still needs some improvement.

ex.zh: 我没法改变昨天发生的事情。
ex.p: wǒ méi fǎ gǎi biàn zuó tiān fā shēng de shì qing
ex.en: I can't change what happened yesterday.

ex.zh: 比赛前我一直都很紧张。
ex.p: bǐ sài qián wǒ yī zhí dōu hěn jǐn zhāng
ex.en: I always get nervous just before a match.

ex.zh: 你看起来真的很紧张。
ex.p: nǐ kàn qǐ lai zhēn de hěn jǐn zhāng
ex.en: You look really nervous.

items.en: to add oil; to top up with gas; to refuel

ex.zh: 我们在下个加油站停一下。
ex.p: wǒ men zài xià gè jiā yóu zhàn tíng yī xià
ex.en: Let's stop at the next gas station.

items.en: to save; to economize; to be frugal; to omit; to delete; to leave out; province

ex.zh: 我在省钱买新车。
ex.p: wǒ zài shěng qián mǎi xīn chē
ex.en: I'm saving up to buy a new car.

ex.zh: 这辆车很省油。
ex.p: zhè liàng chē hěn shěng yóu
ex.en: This car is very economical on gas.

items.en: to accompany; to keep sb company; to assist

ex.zh: 她母亲一直陪着她。
ex.p: tā mǔ qīn yī zhí péi zhe tā
ex.en: Her mother always accompanies her.

ex.zh: 我陪她散步。
ex.p: wǒ péi tā sàn bù
ex.en: I accompanied her on a walk.

ex.zh: 警察正在检查他们的包。
ex.p: jǐng chá zhèng zài jiǎn chá tā men de bāo
ex.en: The police are checking their bags.

ex.zh: 你最好等到警察前来。
ex.p: nǐ zuì hǎo děng dào jǐng chá qián lái
ex.en: You'd better wait until the police come.

items.en: according to; in accordance with; in the light of

ex.zh: 他按照字面上的意思。
ex.p: tā àn zhào zì miàn shǎng de yì si
ex.en: He took it literally.

ex.zh: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。
ex.p: lǎo shī àn zhào shēn gāo gěi hái zi men pái duì
ex.en: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.

ex.zh: 她的花园是一件艺术作品。
ex.p: tā de huā yuán shì yī jiàn yì shù zuò pǐn
ex.en: Her garden is a work of art.

ex.zh: 他们的婚礼将在明天举行。
ex.p: tā men de hūn lǐ jiāng zài míng tiān jǔ xíng
ex.en: Their wedding will be tomorrow.

ex.zh: 会议将在后天于东京举行。
ex.p: huì yì jiāng zài hòu tiān yú dōng jīng jǔ xíng
ex.en: The conference is to be held in Tokyo the day after tomorrow.

ex.zh: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。
ex.p: nà jiù shì nà tái tā yòng lái xiě wén zhāng de diàn nǎo
ex.en: That's the computer he used to write the article.

ex.zh: 你看文章了没？
ex.p: nǐ kàn wén zhāng le méi
ex.en: Did you read the article?

ex.zh: 许多工人死于饥饿。
ex.p: xǔ duō gōng rén sǐ yú jī è
ex.en: Many of the workers died of hunger.

ex.zh: 你真是个努力的工人。
ex.p: nǐ zhēn shì gè nǔ lì de gōng rén
ex.en: You're really a hard worker.

items.en: way of handling sth; method for making; work method

ex.zh: 请问鸡蛋要什么做法？
ex.p: qǐng wèn jī dàn yào shén me zuò fǎ
ex.en: How would you like your eggs?

items.en: to exercise; to keep fit; to work out

ex.zh: 你今天去不去健身房？
ex.p: nǐ jīn tiān qù bù qù jiàn shēn fáng
ex.en: Are you going to the gym today?

items.en: to work a temporary or casual job
master; qualified worker; respectful form of address for older men
to handle official business; to work (esp. in an office)

ex.zh: 在主任不在的时候，办公室由谁来负责？
ex.p: zài zhǔ rèn bù zài de shí hou bàn gōng shì yóu shéi lái fù zé
ex.en: Who is in charge of the office while the boss is away?

ex.zh: 我想给你看看我办公室里的一些东西。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ kàn kàn wǒ bàn gōng shì lǐ de yī xiē dōng xī
ex.en: I want to show you something in my office.

ex.zh: 今天我不加班。
ex.p: jīn tiān wǒ bù jiā bān
ex.en: I won't work overtime today.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第51单元

Work and careers

Grammar focus: 对于; 通过; 按照; 由; writing a short email

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 尽管下着雨，他还是出去了。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn xià zhe yǔ tā hái shi chū qù le
sents.en: He went out in spite of the rain.

sents.zh: 尽管天气很冷，孩子却没有大衣穿。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn tiān qì hěn lěng hái zi què méi yǒu dà yī chuān
sents.en: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.

sents.zh: 这个湖在这个地方很深。
sents.p: zhè gè hú zài zhè gè dì fāng hěn shēn
sents.en: The lake is deep here.

sents.zh: 他穿了一件深色毛衣。
sents.p: tā chuān le yī jiàn shēn sè máo yī
sents.en: He wore a dark sweater.

sents.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。
sents.p: wǒ men tán lùn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de huà tí
sents.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.

sents.zh: 他有各种各样的书。
sents.p: tā yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de shū
sents.en: He has all kinds of books.

sents.zh: 这个想法仍然在我心中。
sents.p: zhè gè xiǎng fǎ réng rán zài wǒ xīn zhōng
sents.en: The idea is still in my mind.

sents.zh: 他仍然时不时来看我。
sents.p: tā réng rán shí bù shí lái kàn wǒ
sents.en: He still comes to see me now and then.

sents.zh: 如果值得一做，就值得做好。
sents.p: rú guǒ zhí de yī zuò jiù zhí de zuò hǎo
sents.en: If it is worth doing at all, it is worth doing well.

sents.zh: 这本书值得再看一遍。
sents.p: zhè běn shū zhí de zài kàn yī biàn
sents.en: This book is worth reading again.

sents.zh: 他有许多不愉快的经历。
sents.p: tā yǒu xǔ duō bù yú kuài de jīng lì
sents.en: He's had many unhappy experiences.

sents.zh: 我们在第三章讨论这个问题。
sents.p: wǒ men zài dì sān zhāng tǎo lùn zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: We'll deal with this problem in Chapter 3.

sents.zh: 我们来讨论下明天吧。
sents.p: wǒ men lái tǎo lùn xià míng tiān ba
sents.en: Let's talk about this tomorrow.

sents.zh: 他应该超过六十岁了。
sents.p: tā yīng gāi chāo guò liù shí suì le
sents.en: He must be over sixty.

sents.zh: 他有超过一百万美元的资产。
sents.p: tā yǒu chāo guò yī bǎi mò měi yuán de zī chǎn
sents.en: He has over a million dollars in assets.

sents.zh: 我仍是这里的老板。
sents.p: wǒ réng shì zhè lǐ de lǎo bǎn
sents.en: I'm still the boss here.

sents.zh: 它仍可能会发生。
sents.p: tā réng kě néng huì fā shēng
sents.en: It still could happen.

sents.zh: “好人不长命”是句或真或假的老话。
sents.p: hǎo rén bù cháng mìng shì gōu huò zhēn huò jià de lǎo huà
sents.en: "The good die young" is an old saying which may or may not be true.

sents.zh: 他休了一周的假。
sents.p: tā xiū le yī zhōu de jià
sents.en: He took a week off.

sents.zh: 我们很高兴你加入了我们班。
sents.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng nǐ jiā rù le wǒ men bān
sents.en: We are glad to have you in our class.

sents.zh: 不是所有国家都加入了联合国。
sents.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu guó jiā dōu jiā rù le lián hé guó
sents.en: Not every country belongs to the U.N.

sents.zh: 他们错把他当成他的兄弟。
sents.p: tā men cuò bǎ tā dàng chéng tā de xiōng dì
sents.en: They mistook him for his brother.

sents.zh: 他有一个兄弟和两个姐妹。
sents.p: tā yǒu yī gè xiōng dì hé liǎng gè jiě mèi
sents.en: He has a brother and two sisters.

sents.zh: 我在信封上写错了地址。
sents.p: wǒ zài xìn fēng shǎng xiě cuò le dì zhǐ
sents.en: I wrote the wrong address on the envelope.

sents.zh: 我不知道他的地址。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā de dì zhǐ
sents.en: I don't know his address.

sents.zh: 你的论文还需要改进。
sents.p: nǐ de lùn wén hái xū yào gǎi jìn
sents.en: Your essay still needs some improvement.

sents.zh: 我没法改变昨天发生的事情。
sents.p: wǒ méi fǎ gǎi biàn zuó tiān fā shēng de shì qing
sents.en: I can't change what happened yesterday.

sents.zh: 比赛前我一直都很紧张。
sents.p: bǐ sài qián wǒ yī zhí dōu hěn jǐn zhāng
sents.en: I always get nervous just before a match.

sents.zh: 你看起来真的很紧张。
sents.p: nǐ kàn qǐ lai zhēn de hěn jǐn zhāng
sents.en: You look really nervous.

sents.zh: 我们在下个加油站停一下。
sents.p: wǒ men zài xià gè jiā yóu zhàn tíng yī xià
sents.en: Let's stop at the next gas station.

sents.zh: 我在省钱买新车。
sents.p: wǒ zài shěng qián mǎi xīn chē
sents.en: I'm saving up to buy a new car.

sents.zh: 这辆车很省油。
sents.p: zhè liàng chē hěn shěng yóu
sents.en: This car is very economical on gas.

sents.zh: 她母亲一直陪着她。
sents.p: tā mǔ qīn yī zhí péi zhe tā
sents.en: Her mother always accompanies her.

sents.zh: 我陪她散步。
sents.p: wǒ péi tā sàn bù
sents.en: I accompanied her on a walk.

sents.zh: 警察正在检查他们的包。
sents.p: jǐng chá zhèng zài jiǎn chá tā men de bāo
sents.en: The police are checking their bags.

sents.zh: 你最好等到警察前来。
sents.p: nǐ zuì hǎo děng dào jǐng chá qián lái
sents.en: You'd better wait until the police come.

sents.zh: 他按照字面上的意思。
sents.p: tā àn zhào zì miàn shǎng de yì si
sents.en: He took it literally.

sents.zh: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。
sents.p: lǎo shī àn zhào shēn gāo gěi hái zi men pái duì
sents.en: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.

sents.zh: 她的花园是一件艺术作品。
sents.p: tā de huā yuán shì yī jiàn yì shù zuò pǐn
sents.en: Her garden is a work of art.

sents.zh: 他们的婚礼将在明天举行。
sents.p: tā men de hūn lǐ jiāng zài míng tiān jǔ xíng
sents.en: Their wedding will be tomorrow.

sents.zh: 会议将在后天于东京举行。
sents.p: huì yì jiāng zài hòu tiān yú dōng jīng jǔ xíng
sents.en: The conference is to be held in Tokyo the day after tomorrow.

sents.zh: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。
sents.p: nà jiù shì nà tái tā yòng lái xiě wén zhāng de diàn nǎo
sents.en: That's the computer he used to write the article.

sents.zh: 你看文章了没？
sents.p: nǐ kàn wén zhāng le méi
sents.en: Did you read the article?

sents.zh: 许多工人死于饥饿。
sents.p: xǔ duō gōng rén sǐ yú jī è
sents.en: Many of the workers died of hunger.

sents.zh: 你真是个努力的工人。
sents.p: nǐ zhēn shì gè nǔ lì de gōng rén
sents.en: You're really a hard worker.

sents.zh: 请问鸡蛋要什么做法？
sents.p: qǐng wèn jī dàn yào shén me zuò fǎ
sents.en: How would you like your eggs?

sents.zh: 你今天去不去健身房？
sents.p: nǐ jīn tiān qù bù qù jiàn shēn fáng
sents.en: Are you going to the gym today?

sents.zh: 在主任不在的时候，办公室由谁来负责？
sents.p: zài zhǔ rèn bù zài de shí hou bàn gōng shì yóu shéi lái fù zé
sents.en: Who is in charge of the office while the boss is away?

sents.zh: 我想给你看看我办公室里的一些东西。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ kàn kàn wǒ bàn gōng shì lǐ de yī xiē dōng xī
sents.en: I want to show you something in my office.

sents.zh: 今天我不加班。
sents.p: jīn tiān wǒ bù jiā bān
sents.en: I won't work overtime today.

sents.zh: 你来这里出差的？
sents.p: nǐ lái zhè lǐ chū chāi de
sents.en: Are you here on business?

sents.zh: 我爸爸经常去美国出差。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba jīng cháng qù měi guó chū chāi
sents.en: My father often goes to America on business.

sents.zh: 我太累了，做不了功课。
sents.p: wǒ tài lěi le zuò bù liǎo gōng kè
sents.en: I'm too sleepy to do my homework.

units.title: Work and careers
units.intro: Grammar focus: 对于; 通过; 按照; 由; writing a short email

ex.zh: 今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。
ex.p: jīn wǎn de yè kōng xīng guāng fēi cháng míng liàng
ex.en: The stars are shining very brightly in the sky tonight.

ex.zh: 我们谈这事谈了一整夜。
ex.p: wǒ men tán zhè shì tán le yī zhěng yè
ex.en: We talked about it all night.

ex.zh: “酒水免费吗？”“仅女士而已。”
ex.p: jiǔ shuǐ miǎn fèi ma jǐn nǚ shì ér yǐ
ex.en: "Are the drinks free?" "Only for ladies."

ex.zh: 这仅是你的想像而已。
ex.p: zhè jǐn shì nǐ de xiǎng xiàng ér yǐ
ex.en: It's just your imagination.

ex.zh: 我在这里等了三十分钟。
ex.p: wǒ zài zhè lǐ děng le sān shí fēn zhōng
ex.en: I've been waiting here for thirty minutes.

ex.zh: 他英文得到了九十分。
ex.p: tā yīng wén dé dào le jiǔ shí fēn
ex.en: He got 90% in English.

items.en: to hang or suspend (from a hook etc)

ex.zh: 她把画挂反了。
ex.p: tā bǎ huà guà fǎn le
ex.en: She hung the picture upside down.

ex.zh: 我不想挂科。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng guà kē
ex.en: I don't want to fail my exams.

ex.zh: 我这个下午本来想去逛街。
ex.p: wǒ zhè gè xià wǔ běn lái xiǎng qù guàng jiē
ex.en: I had intended to go shopping this afternoon.

ex.zh: 本来这间房间里没有家具。
ex.p: běn lái zhè jiān fáng jiān lǐ méi yǒu jiā jù
ex.en: The room originally had no furniture.

ex.zh: 我不想在这些条件下工作。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài zhè xiē tiáo jiàn xià gōng zuò
ex.en: I don't want to work under these conditions.

ex.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。
ex.p: wǒ men zhǐ huì zài nà yàng de tiáo jiàn xià tóng yì
ex.en: We will only consent on that condition.

ex.zh: 我要睡觉了，晚安。
ex.p: wǒ yào shuì jiào le wǎn ān
ex.en: I'm going to bed. Good night.

ex.zh: 我要睡了。晚安。
ex.p: wǒ yào shuì le wǎn ān
ex.en: I'm going to bed. Good night.

ex.zh: 那家公司在广告上花了很多钱。
ex.p: nà jiā gōng sī zài guǎng gào shǎng huā le hěn duō qián
ex.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.

ex.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi jìn zhǐ zhēn duì ér tóng de guǎng gào
ex.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

items.en: to raise (an issue); to propose; to put forward

ex.zh: 她就那件事给他提出建议。
ex.p: tā jiù nà jiàn shì gěi tā tí chū jiàn yì
ex.en: She advised him on that matter.

ex.zh: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng tí chū jiě jué wèn tí de fāng fǎ ma
ex.en: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?

ex.zh: 这正是问题的关键。
ex.p: zhè zhèng shì wèn tí de guān jiàn
ex.en: That's the point.

ex.zh: 这是一个关键点。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè guān jiàn diǎn
ex.en: This is a crucial point.

ex.zh: 我知道他的样子，但不知道他的名字。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào tā de yàng zi dàn bù zhī dào tā de míng zi
ex.en: I know him by sight, but not by name.

ex.zh: 我喜欢她因我的笑话而欢笑的样子。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan tā yīn wǒ de xiào hua ér huan xiào de yàng zi
ex.en: I like the way she laughs at my jokes.

ex.zh: 你必须做出困难的选择。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū zuò chū kùn nan de xuǎn zé
ex.en: You have a difficult choice to make.

ex.zh: 你说你有困难。我能帮忙吗？
ex.p: nǐ shuō nǐ yǒu kùn nan wǒ néng bāng máng ma
ex.en: You said you were in trouble. How can I help?

items.en: specialty; specialized field; main field of study (at university)

ex.zh: 你的专业是什么？
ex.p: nǐ de zhuān yè shì shén me
ex.en: What's your major?

ex.zh: 你选好专业了吗
ex.p: nǐ xuǎn hǎo zhuān yè le ma
ex.en: Have you chosen a major yet?

items.en: don't tell me ...; could it be that...?

ex.zh: 所有文章都必须在规定时间内交上来。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu wén zhāng dōu bì xū zài guī dìng shí jiān nèi jiāo shàng lái
ex.en: All essays must be handed in on time.

items.en: thereupon; as a result; consequently; thus; hence
to arise; to come into being; to come about

ex.zh: 如果我对你产生误解，我实在抱歉。
ex.p: rú guǒ wǒ duì nǐ chǎn shēng wù jiě wǒ shí zài bào qiàn
ex.en: If I've misjudged you, I'm terribly sorry.

ex.zh: 本世纪初以来，产生了很多进步。
ex.p: běn shì jì chū yǐ lái chǎn shēng le hěn duō jìn bù
ex.en: Many improvements have been made since this century began.

items.en: to go through; to know well; (suffix) expert

ex.zh: 他不是个普通的学生。
ex.p: tā bù shì gè pǔ tōng de xué sheng
ex.en: He is no ordinary student.

ex.zh: 我喝咖啡通常加牛奶。
ex.p: wǒ hē kā fēi tōng cháng jiā niú nǎi
ex.en: I usually drink my coffee with milk.

items.en: the other person; the other side; the other party

ex.zh: 他们互相送礼物给对方。
ex.p: tā men hù xiāng sòng lǐ wù gěi duì fāng
ex.en: They give presents to one another.

ex.zh: 我对方言很感兴趣。
ex.p: wǒ duì fāng yán hěn gǎn xìng qù
ex.en: I'm very interested in dialects.

ex.zh: 这个句子在语法上是正确的。
ex.p: zhè gè jù zi zài yǔ fǎ shǎng shì zhèng què de
ex.en: This sentence is grammatically correct.

ex.zh: 顾客永远是正确的吗？
ex.p: gù kè yǒng yuǎn shì zhèng què de ma
ex.en: Is the customer always right?

ex.zh: 他够大方，借了我一点钱。
ex.p: tā gòu dà fāng jiè le wǒ yī diǎn qián
ex.en: He was kind enough to lend me some money.

ex.zh: 我们早饭的面包刚够吃。
ex.p: wǒ men zǎo fàn de miàn bāo gāng gòu chī
ex.en: We have barely enough bread for breakfast.

ex.zh: 第一班火车什么时候出发？
ex.p: dì yī bān huǒ chē shén me shí hou chū fā
ex.en: What time does the first train leave?

ex.zh: 去我们学校比去火车站要远。
ex.p: qù wǒ men xué xiào bǐ qù huǒ chē zhàn yào yuǎn
ex.en: Our school is further away than the station.

ex.zh: 我们本该更加努力学习。
ex.p: wǒ men běn gāi gèng jiā nǔ lì xué xí
ex.en: We should've studied harder.

items.en: a row; a line; to set in order

ex.zh: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。
ex.p: wǒ huì ān pái yī xià jiào gè rén qù nǐ jiā jiē nǐ
ex.en: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.

ex.zh: 我现在在打排球。
ex.p: wǒ xiàn zài zài dá pái qiú
ex.en: I'm playing volleyball now.
