lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第52单元

Work and careers

Grammar focus: 对于; 通过; 按照; 由; writing a short email

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。
sents.p: jīn wǎn de yè kōng xīng guāng fēi cháng míng liàng
sents.en: The stars are shining very brightly in the sky tonight.

sents.zh: 我们谈这事谈了一整夜。
sents.p: wǒ men tán zhè shì tán le yī zhěng yè
sents.en: We talked about it all night.

sents.zh: “酒水免费吗？”“仅女士而已。”
sents.p: jiǔ shuǐ miǎn fèi ma jǐn nǚ shì ér yǐ
sents.en: "Are the drinks free?" "Only for ladies."

sents.zh: 这仅是你的想像而已。
sents.p: zhè jǐn shì nǐ de xiǎng xiàng ér yǐ
sents.en: It's just your imagination.

sents.zh: 我在这里等了三十分钟。
sents.p: wǒ zài zhè lǐ děng le sān shí fēn zhōng
sents.en: I've been waiting here for thirty minutes.

sents.zh: 他英文得到了九十分。
sents.p: tā yīng wén dé dào le jiǔ shí fēn
sents.en: He got 90% in English.

sents.zh: 她把画挂反了。
sents.p: tā bǎ huà guà fǎn le
sents.en: She hung the picture upside down.

sents.zh: 我不想挂科。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng guà kē
sents.en: I don't want to fail my exams.

sents.zh: 我这个下午本来想去逛街。
sents.p: wǒ zhè gè xià wǔ běn lái xiǎng qù guàng jiē
sents.en: I had intended to go shopping this afternoon.

sents.zh: 本来这间房间里没有家具。
sents.p: běn lái zhè jiān fáng jiān lǐ méi yǒu jiā jù
sents.en: The room originally had no furniture.

sents.zh: 我不想在这些条件下工作。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài zhè xiē tiáo jiàn xià gōng zuò
sents.en: I don't want to work under these conditions.

sents.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。
sents.p: wǒ men zhǐ huì zài nà yàng de tiáo jiàn xià tóng yì
sents.en: We will only consent on that condition.

sents.zh: 我要睡觉了，晚安。
sents.p: wǒ yào shuì jiào le wǎn ān
sents.en: I'm going to bed. Good night.

sents.zh: 我要睡了。晚安。
sents.p: wǒ yào shuì le wǎn ān
sents.en: I'm going to bed. Good night.

sents.zh: 那家公司在广告上花了很多钱。
sents.p: nà jiā gōng sī zài guǎng gào shǎng huā le hěn duō qián
sents.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.

sents.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
sents.p: wǒ men yīng gāi jìn zhǐ zhēn duì ér tóng de guǎng gào
sents.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

sents.zh: 她就那件事给他提出建议。
sents.p: tā jiù nà jiàn shì gěi tā tí chū jiàn yì
sents.en: She advised him on that matter.

sents.zh: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng tí chū jiě jué wèn tí de fāng fǎ ma
sents.en: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?

sents.zh: 这正是问题的关键。
sents.p: zhè zhèng shì wèn tí de guān jiàn
sents.en: That's the point.

sents.zh: 这是一个关键点。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè guān jiàn diǎn
sents.en: This is a crucial point.

sents.zh: 我知道他的样子，但不知道他的名字。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào tā de yàng zi dàn bù zhī dào tā de míng zi
sents.en: I know him by sight, but not by name.

sents.zh: 我喜欢她因我的笑话而欢笑的样子。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan tā yīn wǒ de xiào hua ér huan xiào de yàng zi
sents.en: I like the way she laughs at my jokes.

sents.zh: 你必须做出困难的选择。
sents.p: nǐ bì xū zuò chū kùn nan de xuǎn zé
sents.en: You have a difficult choice to make.

sents.zh: 你说你有困难。我能帮忙吗？
sents.p: nǐ shuō nǐ yǒu kùn nan wǒ néng bāng máng ma
sents.en: You said you were in trouble. How can I help?

sents.zh: 你的专业是什么？
sents.p: nǐ de zhuān yè shì shén me
sents.en: What's your major?

sents.zh: 你选好专业了吗
sents.p: nǐ xuǎn hǎo zhuān yè le ma
sents.en: Have you chosen a major yet?

sents.zh: 所有文章都必须在规定时间内交上来。
sents.p: suǒ yǒu wén zhāng dōu bì xū zài guī dìng shí jiān nèi jiāo shàng lái
sents.en: All essays must be handed in on time.

sents.zh: 如果我对你产生误解，我实在抱歉。
sents.p: rú guǒ wǒ duì nǐ chǎn shēng wù jiě wǒ shí zài bào qiàn
sents.en: If I've misjudged you, I'm terribly sorry.

sents.zh: 本世纪初以来，产生了很多进步。
sents.p: běn shì jì chū yǐ lái chǎn shēng le hěn duō jìn bù
sents.en: Many improvements have been made since this century began.

sents.zh: 他不是个普通的学生。
sents.p: tā bù shì gè pǔ tōng de xué sheng
sents.en: He is no ordinary student.

sents.zh: 我喝咖啡通常加牛奶。
sents.p: wǒ hē kā fēi tōng cháng jiā niú nǎi
sents.en: I usually drink my coffee with milk.

sents.zh: 他们互相送礼物给对方。
sents.p: tā men hù xiāng sòng lǐ wù gěi duì fāng
sents.en: They give presents to one another.

sents.zh: 我对方言很感兴趣。
sents.p: wǒ duì fāng yán hěn gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: I'm very interested in dialects.

sents.zh: 这个句子在语法上是正确的。
sents.p: zhè gè jù zi zài yǔ fǎ shǎng shì zhèng què de
sents.en: This sentence is grammatically correct.

sents.zh: 顾客永远是正确的吗？
sents.p: gù kè yǒng yuǎn shì zhèng què de ma
sents.en: Is the customer always right?

sents.zh: 他够大方，借了我一点钱。
sents.p: tā gòu dà fāng jiè le wǒ yī diǎn qián
sents.en: He was kind enough to lend me some money.

sents.zh: 我们早饭的面包刚够吃。
sents.p: wǒ men zǎo fàn de miàn bāo gāng gòu chī
sents.en: We have barely enough bread for breakfast.

sents.zh: 第一班火车什么时候出发？
sents.p: dì yī bān huǒ chē shén me shí hou chū fā
sents.en: What time does the first train leave?

sents.zh: 去我们学校比去火车站要远。
sents.p: qù wǒ men xué xiào bǐ qù huǒ chē zhàn yào yuǎn
sents.en: Our school is further away than the station.

sents.zh: 我们本该更加努力学习。
sents.p: wǒ men běn gāi gèng jiā nǔ lì xué xí
sents.en: We should've studied harder.

sents.zh: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。
sents.p: wǒ huì ān pái yī xià jiào gè rén qù nǐ jiā jiē nǐ
sents.en: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.

sents.zh: 我现在在打排球。
sents.p: wǒ xiàn zài zài dá pái qiú
sents.en: I'm playing volleyball now.

sents.zh: 日本米市场禁止进口。
sents.p: rì běn mǐ shì chǎng jìn zhǐ jìn kǒu
sents.en: Japan's rice market is closed to imports.

sents.zh: 一些学生留下了。
sents.p: yī xiē xué sheng liú xià le
sents.en: Some students stayed behind.

sents.zh: 你为什么留下？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me liú xià
sents.en: Why did you stay?

sents.zh: 教育从家庭开始。
sents.p: jiào yù cóng jiā tíng kāi shǐ
sents.en: Education begins at home.

sents.zh: 他强调了教育的重要性。
sents.p: tā qiáng diào le jiào yù de zhòng yào xìng
sents.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.

sents.zh: 明天是个大日子。
sents.p: míng tiān shì gè dà rì zi
sents.en: Tomorrow's going to be a big day.

sents.zh: 我们所有人都祝福你。
sents.p: wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu zhù fú nǐ
sents.en: Best wishes from all of us.

sents.zh: 我祝你生日快乐。
sents.p: wǒ zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè
sents.en: I wish you a happy birthday.

sents.zh: 我还没有取得那么大的进展。
sents.p: wǒ hái méi yǒu qǔ dé nà me dà de jìn zhǎn
sents.en: I haven't made much progress.

sents.zh: 你需要更有进取心。
sents.p: nǐ xū yào gēng yǒu jìn qǔ xīn
sents.en: You need to be aggressive.

sents.zh: 你在说我有生命危险吗？
sents.p: nǐ zài shuō wǒ yǒu shēng mìng wēi xiǎn ma
sents.en: Are you saying my life is in danger?

sents.zh: 在这条河里游泳很危险。
sents.p: zài zhè tiáo hé lǐ yóu yǒng hěn wēi xiǎn
sents.en: This river is dangerous to swim in.

sents.zh: 如果你弄乱了，你来打扫。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ lòng luàn le nǐ lái dǎ sǎo
sents.en: If you make a mess, clean it up.

sents.zh: 我弟弟的房间总是很乱。
sents.p: wǒ dì di de fáng jiān zǒng shì hěn luàn
sents.en: My brother's room is always a mess.

sents.zh: 那条连衣裙很适合您。
sents.p: nà tiáo lián yī qún hěn shì hé nín
sents.en: That dress looks good on you.

sents.zh: 这条裙子很适合你。
sents.p: zhè tiáo qún zi hěn shì hé nǐ
sents.en: The dress suits you very well.

sents.zh: 你没必要那么正式。
sents.p: nǐ méi bì yào nà me zhèng shì
sents.en: You don't have to be so formal.

sents.zh: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。
sents.p: nín méi bì yào zhǔn bèi yī gè zhèng shì de yǎn jiǎng

ex.p: gōng gòng qì chē duō jiǔ fā chē yī cì

ex.p: tā de ài hào shì huà yǒu huā de tú

items.en: in fact; in reality; as a matter of fact

ex.zh: 你实际上想说什么？
ex.p: nǐ shí jì shàng xiǎng shuō shén me
ex.en: What do you really want to say?

ex.zh: 实际上，我非常无聊。
ex.p: shí jì shàng wǒ fēi cháng wú liáo
ex.en: Actually, it was pretty boring.

items.en: to reach; to achieve; to attain

ex.zh: 我们终于达到了我们的目标。
ex.p: wǒ men zhōng yú dá dào le wǒ men de mù biāo
ex.en: At last, we reached our destination.

ex.zh: 她达到了目标。
ex.p: tā dá dào le mù biāo
ex.en: She has achieved her goals.

items.en: to hold; to carry (in one's arms); to hug

ex.zh: 我很抱歉我没有打电话。
ex.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn wǒ méi yǒu dǎ diàn huà
ex.en: I'm sorry I didn't call.

ex.zh: 抱歉，我把作业落在家里了。
ex.p: bào qiàn wǒ bǎ zuò yè là zài jiā lǐ le
ex.en: I'm sorry, I left my homework at home.

ex.zh: 他本应该成为一个律师。
ex.p: tā běn yīng gāi chéng wéi yī gè lǜ shī
ex.en: He should have been a lawyer.

ex.zh: 他儿子想当律师。
ex.p: tā ér zi xiǎng dāng lǜ shī
ex.en: His son wants to be a lawyer.

ex.zh: 你现在感到痛苦吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiàn zài gǎn dào tòng kǔ ma
ex.en: Are you in pain now?

ex.zh: 现在我有些许头痛。
ex.p: xiàn zài wǒ yǒu xiē xǔ tóu tòng
ex.en: I have a slight headache now.

items.en: spectators; audience; visitors (to an exhibition etc)

ex.zh: 观众深受感动。
ex.p: guān zhòng shēn shòu gǎn dòng
ex.en: The audience was deeply affected.

ex.zh: 他来这里的目的是什么？
ex.p: tā lái zhè lǐ de mù dì shì shén me
ex.en: For what purpose did he come here?

ex.zh: 这是我的目的。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ de mù dì
ex.en: That's my aim.

ex.zh: 英语成为了一门国际语言。
ex.p: yīng yǔ chéng wéi le yī mén guó jì yǔ yán
ex.en: English has become an international language.

ex.zh: 开什么国际玩笑。
ex.p: kāi shén me guó jì wán xiào
ex.en: Don't make stupid jokes.

ex.zh: 从前有个美丽的公主。
ex.p: cóng qián yǒu gè měi lì de gōng zhǔ
ex.en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess.

ex.zh: 你是一个美丽的女人。
ex.p: nǐ shì yī gè měi lì de nǚ rén
ex.en: You're a beautiful young woman.

ex.zh: 我什么经验都没有。
ex.p: wǒ shén me jīng yàn dōu méi yǒu
ex.en: I don't have any experience.

ex.zh: 公司破产了。
ex.p: gōng sī pò chǎn le
ex.en: The company went bankrupt.

ex.zh: 我认为考试破坏教育。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi kǎo shì pò huài jiào yù
ex.en: I think exams ruin education.

items.en: to push; to cut; to refuse

ex.zh: 你推荐我买哪个？
ex.p: nǐ tuī jiàn wǒ mǎi nǎ gè
ex.en: Which one would you recommend I buy?

ex.zh: 她把他推出窗户。

units.intro: Grammar focus: 对于; 通过; 按照; 由; writing a short email

items.en: to oppose; to be against; to object to

ex.zh: 他反对妻子在外工作。
ex.p: tā fǎn duì qī zǐ zài wài gōng zuò
ex.en: He objected to his wife working outside.

ex.zh: 我们反对星期日工作。
ex.p: wǒ men fǎn duì xīng qī rì gōng zuò
ex.en: We are against working on Sundays.

items.en: unexpectedly; to one's surprise; in spite of everything
to recount (e.g. results of election); to re-evaluate

ex.zh: “来杯茶吗？”“嗯，好的。”
ex.p: lái bēi chá ma ēn hǎo de
ex.en: "Would you like some tea?" "Yes, please."

ex.zh: 他的工资是我的两倍。
ex.p: tā de gōng zī shì wǒ de liǎng bèi
ex.en: He earns twice as much as me.

ex.zh: 他赚的钱比我多三倍。
ex.p: tā zhuàn de qián bǐ wǒ duō sān bèi
ex.en: He makes three times more money than I do.

items.en: to wake up; to be awake; to become aware

ex.zh: 今天早晨被头给疼醒了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo chén bèi tóu gěi téng xǐng le
ex.en: I woke up with a headache this morning.

ex.p: wǒ mǔ qīn zuó tiān hěn wǎn hái xǐng zhe

ex.p: wǒ tǎo yàn bié ren ràng wǒ děng hěn jiǔ

ex.p: zhè xiē rén tǎo yàn suǒ yǒu de wài guó rén
ex.en: These people hate all foreigners.

ex.p: wǒ men jiāng huì shū le ma
ex.en: Are we going to lose?

ex.zh: 我们比赛输了。
ex.p: wǒ men bǐ sài shū le
ex.en: We lost the game.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar

HSK 4 · 第54单元

Work and careers

Grammar focus: 对于; 通过; 按照; 由; writing a short email

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我妈年轻的时候非常漂亮。

sents.en: When my mother was young, she was very beautiful.

sents.zh: 我厌烦了他的长篇大论。
sents.p: wǒ yàn fán le tā de cháng piān dà lùn
sents.en: I got bored with his long talk.

sents.zh: 我一直忙于写一部短篇小说。
sents.p: wǒ yī zhí máng yú xiě yī bù duǎn piān xiǎo shuō
sents.en: I've been busy writing a short story.

sents.zh: 儿童应该远离河流。有危险。
sents.p: ér tóng yīng gāi yuǎn lí hé liú yǒu wēi xiǎn
sents.en: Children should keep away from the river. It's dangerous.

sents.zh: 儿童免费入场。
sents.p: ér tóng miǎn fèi rù chǎng
sents.en: Admission is free for children.

sents.zh: 他既会打网球，又会打棒球。
sents.p: tā jì huì dá wǎng qiú yòu huì dá bàng qiú
sents.en: He can play both tennis and baseball.

sents.zh: 我爸爸既不喝酒也不抽烟。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba jì bù hē jiǔ yě bù chōu yān
sents.en: My father neither drinks nor smokes.

sents.zh: 我喜欢西瓜的味道。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan xī guā de wèi dao
sents.en: I like the taste of watermelon.

sents.zh: 这只火鸡味道很好。
sents.p: zhè zhǐ huǒ jī wèi dao hěn hǎo
sents.en: This turkey tastes good.

sents.zh: 千万别误会我的意思。
sents.p: qiān wàn bié wù huì wǒ de yì si
sents.en: Please don't get me wrong.

sents.zh: 他能轻松地读英语。
sents.p: tā néng qīng sōng de dòu yīng yǔ
sents.en: He can read English easily.

sents.zh: 我感觉轻松了。
sents.p: wǒ gǎn jué qīng sōng le
sents.en: I feel relieved.

sents.zh: 你对什么都太怀疑了。
sents.p: nǐ duì shén me dōu tài huái yí le
sents.en: You're too suspicious about everything.

sents.zh: 你喜欢什么样的食物？
sents.p: nǐ xǐ huan shén me yàng de shí wù
sents.en: What type of food do you like?

sents.zh: 我们有足够的食物吗？
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu zú gòu de shí wù ma

sents.zh: 他能赚多少就赚多少。

sents.zh: 他赚的比我多三倍。

sents.zh: 你们能猜到我有什么吗？

sents.zh: 如果你不知道答案，猜猜看。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù zhī dào dá àn cāi cāi kàn

sents.zh: 你应该提前付租金。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi tí qián fù zū jīn
sents.en: You should pay your rent in advance.

sents.zh: 我会让你提前知道。
sents.p: wǒ huì ràng nǐ tí qián zhī dào
sents.en: I will let you know in advance.

sents.zh: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。

sents.zh: 说服他中止旅行真是件苦差事。
sents.p: shuō fú tā zhōng zhǐ lǚ xíng zhēn shì jiàn kǔ chà shì
sents.en: I had a hard time trying to persuade him to cancel the trip.

sents.zh: 一个足球队由十一个球员组成。
sents.p: yī gè zú qiú duì yóu shí yī gè qiú yuán zǔ chéng
sents.en: A soccer team consists of eleven players.

sents.zh: 不要忘记吸烟对你的健康有害。
sents.p: bù yào wàng jì xī yān duì nǐ de jiàn kāng yǒu hài
sents.en: Don't forget smoking is bad for your health.

sents.zh: 我爸爸吸烟很厉害。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba xī yān hěn lì hai
sents.en: My father is a heavy smoker.

sents.zh: 这种说法其实有点可疑。
sents.p: zhè zhǒng shuō fǎ qí shí yǒu diǎn kě yí
sents.en: This statement is actually kind of suspicious.

sents.zh: 在家里，我们只说法语。
sents.p: zài jiā lǐ wǒ men zhǐ shuō fǎ yǔ
sents.en: At home, we speak only French.

sents.zh: 公共汽车上发生什么了？
sents.p: gōng gòng qì chē shǎng fā shēng shén me le
sents.en: What happened on the bus?

sents.zh: 公共汽车多久发车一次？
sents.p: gōng gòng qì chē duō jiǔ fā chē yī cì
sents.en: How often does the bus run?

sents.zh: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。
sents.p: rú guǒ bì yào de huà wǒ bù fǎn duì fù tè bié fèi yòng
sents.en: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.

sents.zh: 每天费用多少？
sents.p: měi tiān fèi yòng duō shǎo
sents.en: What's the daily fee?

sents.zh: 要是不知道路的话去问警察吧。
sents.p: yào shi bù zhī dào lù de huà qù wèn jǐng chá ba
sents.en: If you don't know the way, ask a policeman.

sents.zh: 能否请您给我看一下您的护照？
sents.p: néng fǒu qǐng nín gěi wǒ kàn yī xià nín de hù zhào
sents.en: Will you show me your passport, please?

sents.zh: 我的视力正慢慢下降。
sents.p: wǒ de shì lì zhēng màn màn xià jiàng
sents.en: My eyesight is getting worse.

sents.zh: 气温突然下降了。
sents.p: qì wēn tū rán xià jiàng le
sents.en: The temperature has suddenly dropped.

sents.zh: 为什么你买了旅行保险？
sents.p: wèi shén me nǐ mǎi le lǚ xíng bǎo xiǎn
sents.en: Why did you buy travel insurance?

sents.zh: 他旅行期间，写了旅游日记。
sents.p: tā lǚ xíng qī jiān xiě le lǚ yóu rì jì
sents.en: He kept a diary during the trip.

sents.zh: 铁路与公路平行。
sents.p: tiě lù yú gōng lù píng xíng
sents.en: The railroad is parallel to the road.

sents.zh: 他穿过公路。
sents.p: tā chuān guò gōng lù
sents.en: He crossed the street.

sents.zh: 我不会再说这句话了。
sents.p: wǒ bù huì zài shuō zhè gōu huà le
sents.en: I'm not going to say it again.

sents.zh: 抱歉，你能再说一遍吗？
sents.p: bào qiàn nǐ néng zài shuō yī biàn ma
sents.en: I'm sorry, could you say that again?

sents.zh: 尤其是要有耐心。
sents.p: yóu qí shì yào yǒu nài xīn
sents.en: Above all, be patient.

sents.zh: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。
sents.p: zhè běn zá zhì bù yào rēng wǒ hái méi kàn ne
sents.en: Don't throw out this magazine. I haven't read it yet.

sents.zh: 他扔了很多旧信件。
sents.p: tā rēng le hěn duō jiù xìn jiàn
sents.en: He threw away a bunch of old letters.

sents.zh: 那不是我故意的。
sents.p: nà bù shì wǒ gù yì de
sents.en: That wasn't my intention.

sents.zh: 新闻使她不安。
sents.p: xīn wén shǐ tā bù ān
sents.en: The news distressed her.

sents.zh: 百闻不如一见。
sents.p: bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
sents.en: A picture is worth a thousand words.

sents.zh: 他被视为村里最好的医生。
sents.p: tā bèi shì wéi cūn lǐ zuì hǎo de yī shēng
sents.en: He is regarded as the best doctor in the village.

sents.zh: 能不能麻烦你告诉我去邻村怎么走？
sents.p: néng bù néng má fan nǐ gào sù wǒ qù lín cūn zěn me zǒu
sents.en: Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?

sents.zh: 我不太同意你的看法。
sents.p: wǒ bù tài tóng yì nǐ de kàn fǎ
sents.en: I don't quite agree with you.

sents.zh: 我的看法跟你的不同。
sents.p: wǒ de kàn fǎ gēn nǐ de bù tóng
sents.en: My opinion differs from yours.

units.title: Services: bank, hospital, renting
units.intro: Grammar focus: 竟然; 难道…吗; 尽管

items.en: to lessen; to decrease; to reduce; to lower

ex.zh: 我这个月要减少开支。
ex.p: wǒ zhè gè yuè yào jiǎn shǎo kāi zhī
ex.en: I have to reduce my expenses this month.

ex.zh: 最近我的体重减少了。
ex.p: zuì jìn wǒ de tǐ zhòng jiǎn shǎo le
ex.en: I've lost weight recently.

ex.zh: 他最大的缺点就是话太多。
ex.p: tā zuì dà de quē diǎn jiù shì huà tài duō
ex.en: His greatest fault is talking too much.

ex.zh: 他有他的缺点，但是我爱他。
ex.p: tā yǒu tā de quē diǎn dàn shì wǒ ài tā
ex.en: I love him despite his faults.

ex.zh: 大家辛苦了！
ex.p: dà jiā xīn kǔ le
ex.en: Good job, everyone!

ex.zh: 他们工作的很辛苦。
ex.p: tā men gōng zuò de hěn xīn kǔ
ex.en: They work really hard.

items.en: to remain; to be left; to have as remainder

ex.zh: 冰箱里什么都没剩下。
ex.p: bīng xiāng lǐ shén me dōu méi shèng xià
ex.en: Nothing remained in the refrigerator.

ex.zh: 我把剩下的东西给我的狗吃。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ shèng xià de dōng xī gěi wǒ de gǒu chī
ex.en: I fed the leftovers to my dog.

items.en: just (in time); just right; just enough

ex.zh: 正好那个时候，公交车停下来了。
ex.p: zhèng hǎo nà gè shí hou gōng jiāo chē tíng xià lái le
ex.en: Just then, the bus stopped.

items.en: to reply; to recover; to return (to a previous condition)

ex.zh: 我很抱歉回复晚了。
ex.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn huí fù wǎn le
ex.en: I'm sorry for the late response.

ex.zh: 我一直都相信你的判断。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhí dōu xiāng xìn nǐ de pàn duàn
ex.en: I've always trusted your judgment.

ex.zh: 不要根据封面来判断一本书。
ex.p: bù yào gēn jù fēng miàn lái pàn duàn yī běn shū
ex.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.

ex.zh: 他讲了一个有趣的故事。
ex.p: tā jiǎng le yī gè yǒu qù de gù shì
ex.en: He told a funny story.

ex.zh: 这是本有趣的书，不是吗？
ex.p: zhè shì běn yǒu qù de shū bù shì ma
ex.en: This is an interesting book, isn't it?

ex.zh: 这份工作工资很高。
ex.p: zhè fèn gōng zuò gōng zī hěn gāo
ex.en: That job paid well.

ex.zh: 您想要多少工资？
ex.p: nín xiǎng yào duō shǎo gōng zī
ex.en: How much do you want in terms of salary?

ex.zh: 你给他们的钱会用到好处。
ex.p: nǐ gěi tā men de qián huì yòng dào hǎo chǔ
ex.en: The money you give them will be put to good use.

ex.zh: 我想这药会对您有好处的。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zhè yào huì duì nín yǒu hǎo chǔ de
ex.en: I think this medicine will do you good.

ex.zh: 你是怎样庆祝生日的？
ex.p: nǐ shì zěn yàng qìng zhù shēng rì de
ex.en: How did you celebrate your birthday?

ex.zh: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。
ex.p: hé tong yǐ jīng dào shǒu le nà jiù chū qù qìng zhù yī xià ba
ex.en: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.

items.en: to grieve; to be broken-hearted; to feel deeply hurt

ex.zh: 这个消息让她很伤心。
ex.p: zhè gè xiāo xi ràng tā hěn shāng xīn
ex.en: The news made her sad.

ex.zh: 她看上去很伤心。
ex.p: tā kàn shang qu hěn shāng xīn
ex.en: She looked sad.

items.en: before one's eyes; now; at present

ex.zh: 您很容易就能看出区别。
ex.p: nín hěn róng yì jiù néng kàn chū qū bié
ex.en: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.

ex.zh: “这”和“那”有什么区别？
ex.p: zhè hé nà yǒu shén me qū bié
ex.en: What is the difference between this and that?

items.en: head of a household; family head; patriarch

ex.zh: 他在艺术世家长大。
ex.p: tā zài yì shù shì jiā zhǎng dà
ex.en: He was raised in an artistic family.

items.en: to have confidence in oneself; self-confidence

ex.zh: 你要注意不要太自信。
ex.p: nǐ yào zhù yì bù yào tài zì xìn
ex.en: You should be careful not to become overconfident.

ex.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
ex.p: yào xiǎng chéng gōng zhǐ xū yào wú zhī hé zì xìn
ex.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.

ex.zh: 那部小说我看了三天。
ex.p: nà bù xiǎo shuō wǒ kàn le sān tiān
ex.en: I read the novel in three days.

ex.zh: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？
ex.p: tā zuì hòu yī běn xiǎo shuō de zhǔ tí shì shén me
ex.en: What is the theme of his latest novel?

ex.zh: 今天相比往常，稍暖一些。
ex.p: jīn tiān xiāng bǐ wǎng cháng shāo nuǎn yī xiē
ex.en: Today's a bit warmer than usual.

ex.zh: 请稍等一下。
ex.p: qǐng shāo děng yī xià
ex.en: Please wait a bit.

ex.zh: 他不是医生，他是教师。
ex.p: tā bù shì yī shēng tā shì jiào shī
ex.en: He is not a doctor but a teacher.

ex.zh: 她是女教师。
ex.p: tā shì nǚ jiào shī
ex.en: She is a teacher.

ex.zh: 人们应该被鼓励。
ex.p: rén men yīng gāi bèi gǔ lì
ex.en: People should be encouraged.

ex.zh: 他点头以示鼓励。
ex.p: tā diǎn tóu yǐ shì gǔ lì
ex.en: He nodded encouragingly.

ex.zh: 我们在一个工厂工作。
ex.p: wǒ men zài yī gè gōng chǎng gōng zuò
ex.en: We work in a factory.

ex.zh: 下周工厂可能会关。
ex.p: xià zhōu gōng chǎng kě néng huì guān
ex.en: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.

ex.zh: 他后悔在校时没用功读书。
ex.p: tā hòu huǐ zài xiào shí méi yòng gōng dú shū
ex.en: He regrets not having worked harder at school.

ex.zh: 不要做任何会让你后悔的事。
ex.p: bù yào zuò rèn hé huì ràng nǐ hòu huǐ de shì
ex.en: Don't do anything you'll regret.

ex.zh: 下一场音乐会将在六月份举办。
ex.p: xià yī cháng yīn yuè huì jiāng zài liù yuè fèn jǔ bàn
ex.en: The next concert will take place in June.

items.en: to mention; to raise (a subject); to refer to

ex.zh: 您的名字被提到了。
ex.p: nín de míng zi bèi tí dào le
ex.en: Your name was mentioned.

items.en: not equal to; not as good as; inferior to

ex.zh: 我做得不如以前好了。
ex.p: wǒ zuò de bù rú yǐ qián hǎo le
ex.en: I don't do that as well as I used to.

ex.zh: 坐而言不如起而行。
ex.p: zuò ér yán bù rú qǐ ér xíng
ex.en: Actions speak louder than words.

ex.zh: 顾客永远是正确的吗？
ex.p: gù kè yǒng yuǎn shì zhèng què de ma
ex.en: Is the customer always right?

items.en: (of a contagious disease etc) to spread

ex.zh: 红色不流行了。
ex.p: hóng sè bù liú xíng le
ex.en: Red is out of fashion.

ex.zh: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。
ex.p: xiàn zài nǚ shēng chuān niú zǎi kù hěn liú xíng
ex.en: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.

ex.zh: 我想用信用卡支付。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yòng xìn yòng kǎ zhī fù
ex.en: I'd like to pay by credit card.

ex.zh: 每位会员每月需支付一万日元。
ex.p: měi wèi huì yuán měi yuè xū zhī fù yī mò rì yuán
ex.en: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.

ex.zh: 您要赶快些。
ex.p: nín yào gǎn kuài xiē
ex.en: You have to hurry.

items.en: to arrange; to tidy up; to sort out
bound form having the same meaning as the free word 答, used in 答应, 理 etc

ex.zh: 成千上万的人想要知道答案。
ex.p: chéng qiān shàng wàn de rén xiǎng yào zhī dào dá àn
ex.en: Thousands of people wanted to know the answer.

ex.zh: 我仍然需要一个答案。
ex.p: wǒ réng rán xū yào yī gè dá àn
ex.en: I still need an answer.

ex.zh: 北极熊正在死去。
ex.p: běi jí xióng zhèng zài sǐ qù
ex.en: The polar bears are dying.

sents.en: She looked sad.

sents.zh: 您很容易就能看出区别。
sents.p: nín hěn róng yì jiù néng kàn chū qū bié
sents.en: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.

sents.zh: “这”和“那”有什么区别？
sents.p: zhè hé nà yǒu shén me qū bié
sents.en: What is the difference between this and that?

sents.zh: 他在艺术世家长大。
sents.p: tā zài yì shù shì jiā zhǎng dà
sents.en: He was raised in an artistic family.

sents.zh: 你要注意不要太自信。
sents.p: nǐ yào zhù yì bù yào tài zì xìn
sents.en: You should be careful not to become overconfident.

sents.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
sents.p: yào xiǎng chéng gōng zhǐ xū yào wú zhī hé zì xìn
sents.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.

sents.zh: 那部小说我看了三天。
sents.p: nà bù xiǎo shuō wǒ kàn le sān tiān
sents.en: I read the novel in three days.

sents.zh: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？
sents.p: tā zuì hòu yī běn xiǎo shuō de zhǔ tí shì shén me
sents.en: What is the theme of his latest novel?

sents.zh: 今天相比往常，稍暖一些。
sents.p: jīn tiān xiāng bǐ wǎng cháng shāo nuǎn yī xiē
sents.en: Today's a bit warmer than usual.

sents.zh: 请稍等一下。
sents.p: qǐng shāo děng yī xià
sents.en: Please wait a bit.

sents.zh: 他不是医生，他是教师。
sents.p: tā bù shì yī shēng tā shì jiào shī
sents.en: He is not a doctor but a teacher.

sents.zh: 她是女教师。
sents.p: tā shì nǚ jiào shī
sents.en: She is a teacher.

sents.zh: 人们应该被鼓励。
sents.p: rén men yīng gāi bèi gǔ lì
sents.en: People should be encouraged.

sents.zh: 他点头以示鼓励。
sents.p: tā diǎn tóu yǐ shì gǔ lì
sents.en: He nodded encouragingly.

sents.zh: 我们在一个工厂工作。
sents.p: wǒ men zài yī gè gōng chǎng gōng zuò
sents.en: We work in a factory.

sents.zh: 下周工厂可能会关。
sents.p: xià zhōu gōng chǎng kě néng huì guān
sents.en: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.

sents.zh: 他后悔在校时没用功读书。
sents.p: tā hòu huǐ zài xiào shí méi yòng gōng dú shū
sents.en: He regrets not having worked harder at school.

sents.zh: 不要做任何会让你后悔的事。
sents.p: bù yào zuò rèn hé huì ràng nǐ hòu huǐ de shì
sents.en: Don't do anything you'll regret.

sents.zh: 下一场音乐会将在六月份举办。
sents.p: xià yī cháng yīn yuè huì jiāng zài liù yuè fèn jǔ bàn
sents.en: The next concert will take place in June.

sents.zh: 您的名字被提到了。
sents.p: nín de míng zi bèi tí dào le
sents.en: Your name was mentioned.

sents.zh: 我做得不如以前好了。
sents.p: wǒ zuò de bù rú yǐ qián hǎo le
sents.en: I don't do that as well as I used to.

sents.zh: 坐而言不如起而行。
sents.p: zuò ér yán bù rú qǐ ér xíng
sents.en: Actions speak louder than words.

sents.zh: 顾客永远是正确的吗？
sents.p: gù kè yǒng yuǎn shì zhèng què de ma
sents.en: Is the customer always right?

sents.zh: 红色不流行了。
sents.p: hóng sè bù liú xíng le
sents.en: Red is out of fashion.

sents.zh: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。
sents.p: xiàn zài nǚ shēng chuān niú zǎi kù hěn liú xíng
sents.en: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.

sents.zh: 我想用信用卡支付。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yòng xìn yòng kǎ zhī fù
sents.en: I'd like to pay by credit card.

sents.zh: 每位会员每月需支付一万日元。
sents.p: měi wèi huì yuán měi yuè xū zhī fù yī mò rì yuán
sents.en: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.

sents.zh: 您要赶快些。
sents.p: nín yào gǎn kuài xiē
sents.en: You have to hurry.

sents.zh: 成千上万的人想要知道答案。
sents.p: chéng qiān shàng wàn de rén xiǎng yào zhī dào dá àn
sents.en: Thousands of people wanted to know the answer.

sents.zh: 我仍然需要一个答案。
sents.p: wǒ réng rán xū yào yī gè dá àn
sents.en: I still need an answer.

sents.zh: 北极熊正在死去。
sents.p: běi jí xióng zhèng zài sǐ qù
sents.en: The polar bears are dying.

items.en: to excuse; to forgive; to pardon

ex.zh: 原谅我早上这么早给你打电话。
ex.p: yuán liàng wǒ zǎo shang zhè me zǎo gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
ex.en: Please excuse me for calling you so early in the morning.

ex.zh: 我们已经原谅你了。
ex.p: wǒ men yǐ jīng yuán liàng nǐ le
ex.en: We've forgiven you.

ex.zh: 妈妈，我肚子饿了。
ex.p: mā ma wǒ dù zi è le
ex.en: Mom, I'm hungry.

ex.zh: 我打了他的肚子。
ex.p: wǒ dá le tā de dù zi
ex.en: I hit him in the belly.

ex.zh: 说实话，这对我来说有点太辣了。
ex.p: shuō shí huà zhè duì wǒ lái shuō yǒu diǎn tài là le
ex.en: To tell you the truth, this is a little too spicy for me.

ex.zh: 辣点儿没关系。
ex.p: là diǎn ér méi guān xi
ex.en: I don't mind if it's hot.

ex.zh: 这本小说的作者是谁？
ex.p: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de zuò zhě shì shéi
ex.en: Who's the author of this story?

ex.zh: 这些产品质量同等。
ex.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn zhì liàng tóng děng
ex.en: These products are of the same quality.

ex.zh: 数量不如质量。
ex.p: shù liàng bù rú zhì liàng
ex.en: Quality is more important than quantity.

ex.zh: 谢谢你答应到来。
ex.p: xiè xie nǐ dā ying dào lái
ex.en: Thanks for agreeing to come.

ex.zh: 谢谢您答应到来。
ex.p: xiè xie nín dā ying dào lái
ex.en: Thanks for agreeing to come.

ex.zh: 你度过愉快的时光了吗？
ex.p: nǐ dù guò yú kuài de shí guāng le ma
ex.en: Did you have a good time?

ex.zh: 你怎么样？旅游愉快吗？
ex.p: nǐ zěn me yàng lǚ yóu yú kuài ma
ex.en: How are you? Did you have a good trip?

ex.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。
ex.p: zhǔn què xìng zài jì suàn zhōng hěn zhòng yào
ex.en: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.

ex.zh: 我下周会详细说明的。
ex.p: wǒ xià zhōu huì xiáng xì shuō míng de
ex.en: I'll explain it in detail next week.

items.en: to drop; to fall; to come down

ex.zh: 她降低了收音机的音量。
ex.p: tā jiàng dī le shōu yīn jī de yīn liàng
ex.en: She turned down the radio.

ex.zh: 明天他会在月球降落。
ex.p: míng tiān tā huì zài yuè qiú jiàng luò
ex.en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

items.en: to prohibit; to forbid; to ban

ex.zh: 此处禁止停车。
ex.p: cǐ chù jìn zhǐ tíng chē
ex.en: Parking is prohibited here.

ex.zh: 日本米市场禁止进口。
ex.p: rì běn mǐ shì chǎng jìn zhǐ jìn kǒu
ex.en: Japan's rice market is closed to imports.

items.en: calm; cool-headed; dispassionate; (of a place) deserted; quiet

ex.zh: 我们只须保持冷静。
ex.p: wǒ men zhǐ xū bǎo chí lěng jìng
ex.en: We just need to stay calm.

ex.zh: 我没办法冷静下来。
ex.p: wǒ méi bàn fǎ lěng jìng xià lai
ex.en: I can't calm down.

ex.zh: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？
ex.p: wǒ yào qù gòu wù nǐ yào gēn zhe lái ma
ex.en: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?

ex.zh: 什么时候去购物？
ex.p: shén me shí hou qù gòu wù
ex.en: When are we going shopping?

ex.zh: 上海的人口数量和东京相当。
ex.p: shǎng hǎi de rén kǒu shù liàng hé dōng jīng xiāng dāng
ex.en: The population of Shanghai is as large as that of Tokyo.

ex.zh: 汽车的数量在增长。
ex.p: qì chē de shù liàng zài zēng zhǎng
ex.en: The number of cars is on the increase.

ex.zh: 我喜欢和你一起吃早餐。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan hé nǐ yī qǐ chī zǎo cān
ex.en: I like having breakfast with you.

ex.zh: 我穿著我的睡衣吃早餐。
ex.p: wǒ chuān zhù wǒ de shuì yī chī zǎo cān
ex.en: I ate breakfast in my pajamas.

ex.zh: 当我看到这张图片的时候总是哭。
ex.p: dāng wǒ kàn dào zhè zhāng tú piàn de shí hou zǒng shì kū
ex.en: I always cry when I see this picture.

ex.zh: 我会给你看图片。
ex.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ kàn tú piàn
ex.en: I will show you the picture.

ex.zh: 今天相比往常，稍暖一些。
ex.p: jīn tiān xiāng bǐ wǎng cháng shāo nuǎn yī xiē
ex.en: Today's a bit warmer than usual.

ex.zh: 我觉得她很勇敢。
ex.p: wǒ jué de tā hěn yǒng gǎn
ex.en: I think she is very brave.

ex.zh: 你非常勇敢。
ex.p: nǐ fēi cháng yǒng gǎn
ex.en: You are very brave.

ex.zh: 我购买一本书花费了三十美元。
ex.p: wǒ gòu mǎi yī běn shū huā fèi le sān shí měi yuán
ex.en: I spent thirty dollars on a book.

ex.zh: 您现在不必购买任何东西。
ex.p: nín xiàn zài bù bì gòu mǎi rèn hé dōng xī
ex.en: You don't have to buy anything right now.

ex.zh: 旅行最快的方式是乘飞机。
ex.p: lǚ xíng zuì kuài de fāng shì shì chéng fēi jī
ex.en: The fastest way to travel is by plane.

ex.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
ex.p: chuán zhǎng yào wèi chéng kè ān quán fù zé
ex.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.

items.en: to agree; to conclude; to draw up

ex.zh: 您决定好要下订单了吗？
ex.p: nín jué dìng hǎo yào xià dìng dān le ma
ex.en: Are you ready to order now?

ex.zh: 我想要订房。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào dìng fáng
ex.en: I'd like to reserve a hotel room.

ex.zh: 今天早晨被头给疼醒了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo chén bèi tóu gěi téng xǐng le
ex.en: I woke up with a headache this morning.

ex.zh: 在早晨，我总是喝一杯咖啡。
ex.p: zài zǎo chén wǒ zǒng shì hē yī bēi kā fēi
ex.en: I always drink a cup of coffee in the morning.

ex.zh: 我刚把你家的卫生做完。
ex.p: wǒ gāng bǎ nǐ jiā de wèi shēng zuò wán
ex.en: I just finished cleaning your place.

ex.zh: 孩子们喜欢巧克力。
ex.p: hái zi men xǐ huan qiǎo kè lì
ex.en: Children like chocolate.

ex.zh: 她也喜欢巧克力。
ex.p: tā yě xǐ huan qiǎo kè lì
ex.en: She also likes chocolate.

items.en: to reinforce; to strengthen; to enhance

ex.zh: 她可以为她的女儿感到骄傲。
ex.p: tā kě yǐ wèi tā de nǚ ér gǎn dào jiāo ào
ex.en: She may be proud of her daughter.

ex.zh: 我为我儿子感到骄傲。
ex.p: wǒ wèi wǒ ér zi gǎn dào jiāo ào
ex.en: I'm proud of my son.

ex.zh: 但愿我是一个好歌手。
ex.p: dàn yuàn wǒ shì yī gè hǎo gē shǒu
ex.en: I wish I were a good singer.

ex.zh: 你不是歌手。
ex.p: nǐ bù shì gē shǒu
ex.en: You're no singer.

ex.zh: 你觉得那些日本作家怎么样？
ex.p: nǐ jué de nà xiē rì běn zuò jiā zěn me yàng
ex.en: What do you think of those Japanese writers?

ex.zh: 他是位出色的作家。
ex.p: tā shì wèi chū sè de zuò jiā
ex.en: He is a good writer.

items.en: in all parts of (a country); various regions
ripe; mature; thoroughly cooked; done; familiar; acquainted

ex.zh: 他选每个词都深思熟虑。
ex.p: tā xuǎn měi gè cí dōu shēn sī shú lǜ
ex.en: He chose every word with care.

ex.zh: 孩子在母亲的怀中熟睡。
ex.p: hái zi zài mǔ qīn de huái zhōng shú shuì
ex.en: The baby was fast asleep in her mother's arms.

items.en: to reduce; to lower; to bring down

ex.zh: 她降低了收音机的音量。
ex.p: tā jiàng dī le shōu yīn jī de yīn liàng
ex.en: She turned down the radio.

ex.zh: 他们正努力降低成本。
ex.p: tā men zhēng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn
ex.en: They're trying to keep costs down.

ex.zh: 我妹妹正在厨房做饭。
ex.p: wǒ mèi mei zhèng zài chú fáng zuò fàn
ex.en: My sister is cooking in the kitchen.

ex.zh: 美式厨房比日式的大。
ex.p: měi shì chú fáng bǐ rì shì de dà
ex.en: American kitchens are much bigger than Japanese ones.

ex.zh: 课程下周开始。
ex.p: kè chéng xià zhōu kāi shǐ
ex.en: Classes begin next week.

ex.zh: 她全身都疼。
ex.p: tā quán shēn dōu téng
ex.en: She was aching all over.

ex.zh: 我全身疼痛。
ex.p: wǒ quán shēn téng tòng
ex.en: My whole body hurts.

sents.p: wǒ men zhǐ xū bǎo chí lěng jìng
sents.en: We just need to stay calm.

sents.zh: 我没办法冷静下来。
sents.p: wǒ méi bàn fǎ lěng jìng xià lai
sents.en: I can't calm down.

sents.zh: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？
sents.p: wǒ yào qù gòu wù nǐ yào gēn zhe lái ma
sents.en: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?

sents.zh: 什么时候去购物？
sents.p: shén me shí hou qù gòu wù
sents.en: When are we going shopping?

sents.zh: 上海的人口数量和东京相当。
sents.p: shǎng hǎi de rén kǒu shù liàng hé dōng jīng xiāng dāng
sents.en: The population of Shanghai is as large as that of Tokyo.

sents.zh: 汽车的数量在增长。
sents.p: qì chē de shù liàng zài zēng zhǎng
sents.en: The number of cars is on the increase.

sents.zh: 我喜欢和你一起吃早餐。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan hé nǐ yī qǐ chī zǎo cān
sents.en: I like having breakfast with you.

sents.zh: 我穿著我的睡衣吃早餐。
sents.p: wǒ chuān zhù wǒ de shuì yī chī zǎo cān
sents.en: I ate breakfast in my pajamas.

sents.zh: 当我看到这张图片的时候总是哭。
sents.p: dāng wǒ kàn dào zhè zhāng tú piàn de shí hou zǒng shì kū
sents.en: I always cry when I see this picture.

sents.zh: 我会给你看图片。
sents.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ kàn tú piàn
sents.en: I will show you the picture.

sents.zh: 今天相比往常，稍暖一些。
sents.p: jīn tiān xiāng bǐ wǎng cháng shāo nuǎn yī xiē
sents.en: Today's a bit warmer than usual.

sents.zh: 我觉得她很勇敢。
sents.p: wǒ jué de tā hěn yǒng gǎn
sents.en: I think she is very brave.

sents.zh: 你非常勇敢。
sents.p: nǐ fēi cháng yǒng gǎn
sents.en: You are very brave.

sents.zh: 我购买一本书花费了三十美元。
sents.p: wǒ gòu mǎi yī běn shū huā fèi le sān shí měi yuán
sents.en: I spent thirty dollars on a book.

sents.zh: 您现在不必购买任何东西。
sents.p: nín xiàn zài bù bì gòu mǎi rèn hé dōng xī
sents.en: You don't have to buy anything right now.

sents.zh: 旅行最快的方式是乘飞机。
sents.p: lǚ xíng zuì kuài de fāng shì shì chéng fēi jī
sents.en: The fastest way to travel is by plane.

sents.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
sents.p: chuán zhǎng yào wèi chéng kè ān quán fù zé
sents.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.

sents.zh: 您决定好要下订单了吗？
sents.p: nín jué dìng hǎo yào xià dìng dān le ma
sents.en: Are you ready to order now?

sents.zh: 我想要订房。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào dìng fáng
sents.en: I'd like to reserve a hotel room.

sents.zh: 今天早晨被头给疼醒了。
sents.p: jīn tiān zǎo chén bèi tóu gěi téng xǐng le
sents.en: I woke up with a headache this morning.

sents.zh: 在早晨，我总是喝一杯咖啡。
sents.p: zài zǎo chén wǒ zǒng shì hē yī bēi kā fēi
sents.en: I always drink a cup of coffee in the morning.

sents.zh: 我刚把你家的卫生做完。
sents.p: wǒ gāng bǎ nǐ jiā de wèi shēng zuò wán
sents.en: I just finished cleaning your place.

sents.zh: 孩子们喜欢巧克力。
sents.p: hái zi men xǐ huan qiǎo kè lì
sents.en: Children like chocolate.

sents.zh: 她也喜欢巧克力。
sents.p: tā yě xǐ huan qiǎo kè lì
sents.en: She also likes chocolate.

sents.zh: 她可以为她的女儿感到骄傲。
sents.p: tā kě yǐ wèi tā de nǚ ér gǎn dào jiāo ào
sents.en: She may be proud of her daughter.

sents.zh: 我为我儿子感到骄傲。
sents.p: wǒ wèi wǒ ér zi gǎn dào jiāo ào
sents.en: I'm proud of my son.

sents.zh: 但愿我是一个好歌手。
sents.p: dàn yuàn wǒ shì yī gè hǎo gē shǒu
sents.en: I wish I were a good singer.

sents.zh: 你不是歌手。
sents.p: nǐ bù shì gē shǒu
sents.en: You're no singer.

sents.zh: 你觉得那些日本作家怎么样？
sents.p: nǐ jué de nà xiē rì běn zuò jiā zěn me yàng
sents.en: What do you think of those Japanese writers?

sents.zh: 他是位出色的作家。
sents.p: tā shì wèi chū sè de zuò jiā
sents.en: He is a good writer.

sents.zh: 他选每个词都深思熟虑。
sents.p: tā xuǎn měi gè cí dōu shēn sī shú lǜ
sents.en: He chose every word with care.

sents.zh: 孩子在母亲的怀中熟睡。
sents.p: hái zi zài mǔ qīn de huái zhōng shú shuì
sents.en: The baby was fast asleep in her mother's arms.

sents.zh: 他们正努力降低成本。
sents.p: tā men zhēng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn
sents.en: They're trying to keep costs down.

sents.zh: 我妹妹正在厨房做饭。
sents.p: wǒ mèi mei zhèng zài chú fáng zuò fàn
sents.en: My sister is cooking in the kitchen.

sents.zh: 美式厨房比日式的大。
sents.p: měi shì chú fáng bǐ rì shì de dà
sents.en: American kitchens are much bigger than Japanese ones.

sents.zh: 课程下周开始。
sents.p: kè chéng xià zhōu kāi shǐ
sents.en: Classes begin next week.

sents.zh: 她全身都疼。
sents.p: tā quán shēn dōu téng
sents.en: She was aching all over.

sents.zh: 我全身疼痛。
sents.p: wǒ quán shēn téng tòng
sents.en: My whole body hurts.

ex.zh: 昨天太冷了，我只好待在家里。
ex.p: zuó tiān tài lěng le wǒ zhǐ hǎo dāi zài jiā lǐ

ex.zh: 出国的人数一直在增加。

ex.zh: 这是我所知道的最好的餐厅。

ex.zh: 我推荐这个餐厅。
ex.p: wǒ tuī jiàn zhè gè cān tīng
ex.en: I can recommend this restaurant.

ex.zh: 我对亚洲的历史很感兴趣。
ex.p: wǒ duì yà zhōu de lì shǐ hěn gǎn xìng qù
ex.en: I'm interested in Asian history.

ex.zh: 日本在亚洲。
ex.p: rì běn zài yà zhōu
ex.en: Japan is in Asia.

ex.zh: 我为昨天发生的事道歉。
ex.p: wǒ wèi zuó tiān fā shēng de shì dào qiàn
ex.en: I apologize for yesterday.

ex.zh: 我们没有收到过道歉。
ex.p: wǒ men méi yǒu shōu dào guò dào qiàn
ex.en: We didn't get an apology.

ex.zh: 今天下午到我家来一趟。
ex.p: jīn tiān xià wǔ dào wǒ jiā lái yī tāng
ex.en: Come to my house this afternoon.

ex.zh: 我就只告诉你，我不喜欢我们的新队长。
ex.p: wǒ jiù zhǐ gào sù nǐ wǒ bù xǐ huan wǒ men de xīn duì zhǎng
ex.en: Between you and me, I don't like our new team captain.

ex.zh: 我们选她为我们队的队长。
ex.p: wǒ men xuǎn tā wèi wǒ men duì de duì zhǎng
ex.en: We elected her captain of our team.

ex.zh: 他们正向森林而去。
ex.p: tā men zhēng xiàng sēn lín ér qù
ex.en: They are making for the forest.

ex.zh: 你可以在这片森林里看到很多动物。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ zài zhè piān sēn lín lǐ kàn dào hěn duō dòng wù
ex.en: You can see many animals in this forest.

ex.zh: 我认为这外套应该适合你。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè wài tào yīng gāi shì hé nǐ
ex.en: I think this coat should fit you.

ex.zh: 他穿上了黑色的外套。
ex.p: tā chuān shang le hēi sè de wài tào
ex.en: He put on the black coat.

ex.zh: 我听到聚会的事很高兴。
ex.p: wǒ tīng dào jù huì de shì hěn gāo xìng
ex.en: I'm very happy to hear about the party.

ex.zh: 聚会上我和他谈得很愉快。
ex.p: jù huì shǎng wǒ hé tā tán de hěn yú kuài
ex.en: I enjoyed talking with him at the party.

items.en: to use in; to use on; to use for

ex.zh: 这个学校的学生很友好。
ex.p: zhè gè xué xiào de xué sheng hěn yǒu hǎo
ex.en: The students of this school are kind.

ex.zh: 你和他都很友好。
ex.p: nǐ hé tā dōu hěn yǒu hǎo
ex.en: You and he are both very kind.

items.en: to congregate; to assemble; to mass

ex.zh: 我们每周在这儿聚一次。

ex.zh: 会不会只有我一个人去聚会？
ex.p: huì bù huì zhǐ yǒu wǒ yī gè rén qù jù huì
ex.en: Will I be the only one going to the party?

items.en: to roast; to bake; to broil

ex.zh: 谢谢你烤的美味蛋糕。
ex.p: xiè xie nǐ kǎo de měi wèi dàn gāo
ex.en: Thank you for baking this delicious cake.

ex.zh: 我喜欢烧烤食物。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan shāo kǎo shí wù
ex.en: I love barbecue.

items.en: to put in order; to tidy up; to pack

ex.zh: 她经常在饭后收拾桌子。
ex.p: tā jīng cháng zài fàn hòu shōu shi zhuō zi
ex.en: She always clears the table after a meal.

ex.zh: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zài wǒ fù mǔ lái zhī qián shōu shi gān jìng wū zi
ex.en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.

items.en: for example; for instance; such as
to look over; to examine; to check up

ex.zh: 你可以给我举个例子吗？
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ jǔ gè lì zi ma
ex.en: Can you give me an example?

ex.zh: 让我来给你举个例子吧。
ex.p: ràng wǒ lái gěi nǐ jǔ gè lì zi ba
ex.en: Let me give you an example.

ex.zh: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。
ex.p: tā dé dào le bǐ wǒ men hái gāo de fēn shù
ex.en: He got a better score than us.

to enter a school or college; to go to school for the first time as a child

ex.zh: 我听说你通过了入学考试。恭喜你了！

ex.zh: 他在入学考试中失败了。
ex.p: tā zài rù xué kǎo shì zhōng shī bài le
ex.en: He failed the entrance exam.

ex.p: yǐ qián wǒ jiā qián miàn yǒu kē dà sōng shù

ex.p: bié zhè me cū xīn

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第64单元

Education and learning

Grammar focus: 不仅…还; 甚至; 否则

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我和平常一样起得早。
sents.p: wǒ hé píng cháng yī yàng qǐ de zǎo
sents.en: I got up early as usual.

sents.zh: 我比平常晚到。
sents.p: wǒ bǐ píng cháng wǎn dào
sents.en: I arrived later than usual.

sents.zh: 这是个文字游戏。
sents.p: zhè shì gè wén zì yóu xì
sents.en: This is a pun.

sents.zh: 本来这间房间里没有家具。
sents.p: běn lái zhè jiān fáng jiān lǐ méi yǒu jiā jù
sents.en: The room originally had no furniture.

sents.zh: 用优质材料做的家具卖得很好。
sents.p: yòng yōu zhì cái liào zuò de jiā jù mài de hěn hǎo
sents.en: Furniture made of good materials sells well.

sents.zh: 以前我家前面有棵大松树。
sents.p: yǐ qián wǒ jiā qián miàn yǒu kē dà sōng shù
sents.en: There used to be a big pine tree in front of my house.

sents.zh: 她在一棵树下坐着。
sents.p: tā zài yī kē shù xià zuò zhe
sents.en: She was sitting under a tree.

sents.zh: 别这么粗心！
sents.p: bié zhè me cū xīn
sents.en: Don't be so careless!

sents.zh: 我不知道该和谁商量好。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi hé shéi shāng liang hǎo
sents.en: I don't know who to consult with.

sents.zh: 有件事我一直想跟你商量。
sents.p: yǒu jiàn shì wǒ yī zhí xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liang
sents.en: There's something I've been meaning to discuss with you.

sents.zh: 你今天午餐吃什么？
sents.p: nǐ jīn tiān wǔ cān chī shén me
sents.en: What will you have for lunch today?

sents.zh: 要一起吃午餐吗？
sents.p: yào yī qǐ chī wǔ cān ma
sents.en: Would you like to eat lunch together?

sents.zh: 在这儿等到他回来为止。
sents.p: zài zhèr děng dào tā huí lai wéi zhǐ
sents.en: Wait here till he comes back.

sents.zh: 为什么你不在这里等到我做完为止？
sents.p: wèi shén me nǐ bù zài zhè lǐ děng dào wǒ zuò wán wéi zhǐ
sents.en: Why don't you wait here while I finish what I'm doing?

sents.zh: 在这里稍微休息一下吧。
sents.p: zài zhè lǐ shāo wēi xiū xi yī xià ba
sents.en: Let's rest here.

sents.zh: 稍微冷一点没关系。
sents.p: shāo wēi lěng yī diǎn méi guān xi
sents.en: I don't mind if it's a little cold.

sents.zh: 他开始出汗了。
sents.p: tā kāi shǐ chū hàn le
sents.en: He began to sweat.

sents.zh: 我正流着汗。
sents.p: wǒ zhēng liú zhe hán
sents.en: I'm dripping with sweat.

sents.zh: 水是生命所不可缺少的。
sents.p: shuǐ shì shēng mìng suǒ bù kě quē shǎo de
sents.en: Water is essential to life.

sents.zh: 我的家乡非常漂亮。
sents.p: wǒ de jiā xiāng fēi cháng piào liang
sents.en: My hometown is very pretty.

sents.zh: 一些人通过阅读来放松。
sents.p: yī xiē rén tōng guò yuè dú lái fàng sōng
sents.en: Some people relax by reading.

sents.zh: 我一点都不喜欢阅读。
sents.p: wǒ yī diǎn dōu bù xǐ huan yuè dú
sents.en: I don't like reading at all.

sents.zh: 大多数的事故都发生在家附近。
sents.p: dà duō shù de shì gù dōu fā shēng zài jiā fù jìn

sents.zh: 她把他推出窗户。

sents.en: Maybe it was just a coincidence.

sents.p: kě néng zhǐ shì qiǎo hé
sents.en: It could be just a coincidence.

units.title: Education and learning
units.intro: Grammar focus: 不仅…还; 甚至; 否则

ex.zh: 他们是从法国南部来的。
ex.p: tā men shì cóng fǎ guó nán bù lái de
ex.en: They come from the south of France.

items.en: to disturb; to bother; to trouble

ex.zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。
ex.p: nǐ kǎo lǜ zhōu dào méi yǒu dǎ rǎo wǒ men
ex.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.

ex.zh: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。
ex.p: wǒ huì jǐn liàng bù dǎ rǎo nǐ fù xí
ex.en: I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.

ex.zh: 他住在松江七年了。
ex.p: tā zhù zài sōng jiāng qī nián le
ex.en: He lived in Matsue for seven years.

ex.zh: 我们的老师非常有幽默感。
ex.p: wǒ men de lǎo shī fēi cháng yǒu yōu mò gǎn
ex.en: Our teacher has a wonderful sense of humor.

ex.zh: 你有种奇怪的幽默感。
ex.p: nǐ yǒu zhǒng qí guài de yōu mò gǎn
ex.en: You have a strange sense of humor.

ex.zh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。
ex.p: sù liào pán zi zài kǎo xiāng lǐ huì huā de
ex.en: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.

items.en: to dream; to have a dream; fig. illusion

ex.zh: 我感觉就像做梦一样。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn jué jiù xiàng zuò mèng yī yàng
ex.en: I felt as if I were in a dream.

ex.zh: 我还以为我在做梦呢。
ex.p: wǒ hái yǐ wéi wǒ zài zuò mèng ne
ex.en: I thought I was dreaming.

ex.zh: 我不想有任何误会。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng yǒu rèn hé wù huì
ex.en: I don't want there to be any misunderstanding.

ex.zh: 我很抱歉误会了您。
ex.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn wù huì le nín
ex.en: I'm sorry I misunderstood you.

items.en: (coll.) a star; the stars in the sky

ex.zh: 这是一本关于星星的书。
ex.p: zhè shì yī běn guān yú xīng xing de shū
ex.en: This is a book about stars.

ex.zh: 这是本关于星星的书。
ex.p: zhè shì běn guān yú xīng xing de shū
ex.en: This is a book about stars.

items.en: to gain; to get; to acquire
to be sorry; to feel apologetic; sorry!

ex.zh: 让您等了很久，我很抱歉。
ex.p: ràng nín děng le hěn jiǔ wǒ hěn bào qiàn
ex.en: I'm sorry I've kept you waiting so long.

ex.zh: 很抱歉我伤害了你。
ex.p: hěn bào qiàn wǒ shāng hài le nǐ
ex.en: I'm sorry I hurt you.

ex.zh: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn tā hěn fù yǒu tā hái shi bù mǎn jù
ex.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.

ex.zh: 他对结果不满意。
ex.p: tā duì jiē guǒ bù mǎn yì
ex.en: He is unsatisfied with the result.

ex.zh: 你一天照几次镜子？
ex.p: nǐ yī tiān zhào jī cì jìng zi
ex.en: How many times a day do you look at yourself in the mirror?

ex.zh: 她站在镜子前。
ex.p: tā zhàn zài jìng zi qián
ex.en: She stood in front of the mirror.

items.en: to keep up with; to catch up with; to overtake

ex.zh: 我们能赶上最后一班火车。
ex.p: wǒ men néng gǎn shàng zuì hòu yī bān huǒ chē
ex.en: We were able to catch the last train.

ex.zh: 我必须赶上头班火车。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū gǎn shàng tóu bān huǒ chē
ex.en: I must catch the first train.

items.en: to meet the standard required; qualified; eligible (voter etc)

ex.zh: 她是个合格的护士。
ex.p: tā shì gè hé gé de hù shi
ex.en: She is qualified as a nurse.

ex.zh: 没有合格的申请人吗？
ex.p: méi yǒu hé gé de shēn qǐng rén ma
ex.en: Aren't there any qualified applicants?

ex.zh: 她没有任何亲戚朋友照顾她。
ex.p: tā méi yǒu rèn hé qīn qi péng you zhào gu tā
ex.en: She doesn't have any friends or relatives to take care of her.

items.en: guqin 琴 (a type of zither); musical instrument in general

ex.zh: 我做钢琴调音师很多年了。
ex.p: wǒ zuò gāng qín diào yīn shī hěn duō nián le
ex.en: I worked as a piano tuner for many years.

ex.zh: 我妹妹每周上两次钢琴课。
ex.p: wǒ mèi mei měi zhōu shǎng liǎng cì gāng qín kè
ex.en: My sister takes piano lessons twice a week.

ex.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
ex.p: diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
ex.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.

ex.zh: 我没力气了。
ex.p: wǒ méi lì qi le
ex.en: I have no strength.

ex.zh: 我没力气继续尝试了。
ex.p: wǒ méi lì qi jì xù cháng shì le
ex.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.

ex.zh: 你们的优点和缺点是什么？
ex.p: nǐ men de yōu diǎn hé quē diǎn shì shén me
ex.en: What are your strengths and weaknesses?

ex.zh: 电视的确有一些缺点。
ex.p: diàn shì dí què yǒu yī xiē quē diǎn
ex.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.

items.en: to defeat; to overpower; to beat

ex.zh: 他永远不会打败我的。
ex.p: tā yǒng yuǎn bù huì dǎ bài wǒ de
ex.en: He'll never beat me.

items.en: to go on holidays; to spend one's vacation

ex.zh: 你认为你会到哪儿度假？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi nǐ huì dào nǎr dù jià
ex.en: Where do you suppose you'll spend your vacation?

ex.zh: 她在海边有一个度假屋。
ex.p: tā zài hǎi biān yǒu yī gè dù jià wū
ex.en: She has a cottage by the sea.

ex.zh: 老虎吃什么东西？
ex.p: lǎo hǔ chī shén me dōng xī
ex.en: What do tigers eat?

ex.zh: 这不是老虎。
ex.p: zhè bù shì lǎo hǔ
ex.en: This isn't a tiger.

ex.zh: 停车场是免费的。
ex.p: tíng chē chǎng shì miǎn fèi de
ex.en: The parking lot is free of charge.

ex.zh: 他以前是个诚实的人。
ex.p: tā yǐ qián shì gè chéng shí de rén
ex.en: He was an honest man.

ex.zh: 我认为她是一个诚实的女人。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi tā shì yī gè chéng shí de nǚ rén
ex.en: I think she's an honest woman.

ex.zh: 她给他一件毛衣。
ex.p: tā gěi tā yī jiàn máo yī
ex.en: She gave him a sweater.

ex.zh: 她穿著羊毛衣。
ex.p: tā chuān zhù yáng máo yī
ex.en: She was dressed in wool.

items.en: to drop in; to visit; to lock a door

ex.zh: 童年时我会去海里游泳。
ex.p: tóng nián shí wǒ huì qù hǎi lǐ yóu yǒng
ex.en: I used to go swimming in the sea when I was a child.

ex.zh: 我的童年很快乐。
ex.p: wǒ de tóng nián hěn kuài lè
ex.en: I had a happy childhood.

lines.en: He lived in Matsue for seven years.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第65单元

Education and learning

Grammar focus: 不仅…还; 甚至; 否则

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 他们是从法国南部来的。
sents.p: tā men shì cóng fǎ guó nán bù lái de
sents.en: They come from the south of France.

sents.zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。
sents.p: nǐ kǎo lǜ zhōu dào méi yǒu dǎ rǎo wǒ men
sents.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.

sents.zh: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。
sents.p: wǒ huì jǐn liàng bù dǎ rǎo nǐ fù xí
sents.en: I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.

sents.zh: 他住在松江七年了。
sents.p: tā zhù zài sōng jiāng qī nián le
sents.en: He lived in Matsue for seven years.

sents.zh: 我们的老师非常有幽默感。
sents.p: wǒ men de lǎo shī fēi cháng yǒu yōu mò gǎn
sents.en: Our teacher has a wonderful sense of humor.

sents.zh: 你有种奇怪的幽默感。
sents.p: nǐ yǒu zhǒng qí guài de yōu mò gǎn
sents.en: You have a strange sense of humor.

sents.zh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。
sents.p: sù liào pán zi zài kǎo xiāng lǐ huì huā de
sents.en: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.

sents.zh: 我感觉就像做梦一样。
sents.p: wǒ gǎn jué jiù xiàng zuò mèng yī yàng
sents.en: I felt as if I were in a dream.

sents.zh: 我还以为我在做梦呢。
sents.p: wǒ hái yǐ wéi wǒ zài zuò mèng ne
sents.en: I thought I was dreaming.

sents.zh: 我不想有任何误会。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng yǒu rèn hé wù huì
sents.en: I don't want there to be any misunderstanding.

sents.zh: 我很抱歉误会了您。
sents.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn wù huì le nín
sents.en: I'm sorry I misunderstood you.

sents.zh: 这是一本关于星星的书。
sents.p: zhè shì yī běn guān yú xīng xing de shū
sents.en: This is a book about stars.

sents.zh: 这是本关于星星的书。
sents.p: zhè shì běn guān yú xīng xing de shū
sents.en: This is a book about stars.

sents.zh: 让您等了很久，我很抱歉。
sents.p: ràng nín děng le hěn jiǔ wǒ hěn bào qiàn
sents.en: I'm sorry I've kept you waiting so long.

sents.zh: 很抱歉我伤害了你。
sents.p: hěn bào qiàn wǒ shāng hài le nǐ
sents.en: I'm sorry I hurt you.

sents.zh: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn tā hěn fù yǒu tā hái shi bù mǎn jù
sents.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.

sents.zh: 他对结果不满意。
sents.p: tā duì jiē guǒ bù mǎn yì
sents.en: He is unsatisfied with the result.

sents.zh: 你一天照几次镜子？
sents.p: nǐ yī tiān zhào jī cì jìng zi
sents.en: How many times a day do you look at yourself in the mirror?

sents.zh: 她站在镜子前。
sents.p: tā zhàn zài jìng zi qián
sents.en: She stood in front of the mirror.

sents.zh: 我们能赶上最后一班火车。
sents.p: wǒ men néng gǎn shàng zuì hòu yī bān huǒ chē
sents.en: We were able to catch the last train.

sents.zh: 我必须赶上头班火车。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū gǎn shàng tóu bān huǒ chē
sents.en: I must catch the first train.

sents.zh: 她是个合格的护士。
sents.p: tā shì gè hé gé de hù shi
sents.en: She is qualified as a nurse.

sents.zh: 没有合格的申请人吗？
sents.p: méi yǒu hé gé de shēn qǐng rén ma
sents.en: Aren't there any qualified applicants?

sents.zh: 她没有任何亲戚朋友照顾她。
sents.p: tā méi yǒu rèn hé qīn qi péng you zhào gu tā
sents.en: She doesn't have any friends or relatives to take care of her.

sents.zh: 我做钢琴调音师很多年了。
sents.p: wǒ zuò gāng qín diào yīn shī hěn duō nián le
sents.en: I worked as a piano tuner for many years.

sents.zh: 我妹妹每周上两次钢琴课。
sents.p: wǒ mèi mei měi zhōu shǎng liǎng cì gāng qín kè
sents.en: My sister takes piano lessons twice a week.

sents.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
sents.p: diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
sents.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.

sents.zh: 我没力气了。
sents.p: wǒ méi lì qi le
sents.en: I have no strength.

sents.zh: 我没力气继续尝试了。
sents.p: wǒ méi lì qi jì xù cháng shì le
sents.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.

sents.zh: 你们的优点和缺点是什么？
sents.p: nǐ men de yōu diǎn hé quē diǎn shì shén me
sents.en: What are your strengths and weaknesses?

sents.zh: 电视的确有一些缺点。
sents.p: diàn shì dí què yǒu yī xiē quē diǎn
sents.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.

sents.zh: 他永远不会打败我的。
sents.p: tā yǒng yuǎn bù huì dǎ bài wǒ de
sents.en: He'll never beat me.

sents.zh: 你认为你会到哪儿度假？
sents.p: nǐ rèn wéi nǐ huì dào nǎr dù jià
sents.en: Where do you suppose you'll spend your vacation?

sents.zh: 她在海边有一个度假屋。
sents.p: tā zài hǎi biān yǒu yī gè dù jià wū
sents.en: She has a cottage by the sea.

sents.zh: 老虎吃什么东西？
sents.p: lǎo hǔ chī shén me dōng xī
sents.en: What do tigers eat?

sents.zh: 这不是老虎。
sents.p: zhè bù shì lǎo hǔ
sents.en: This isn't a tiger.

sents.zh: 停车场是免费的。
sents.p: tíng chē chǎng shì miǎn fèi de
sents.en: The parking lot is free of charge.

sents.zh: 他以前是个诚实的人。
sents.p: tā yǐ qián shì gè chéng shí de rén
sents.en: He was an honest man.

sents.zh: 我认为她是一个诚实的女人。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi tā shì yī gè chéng shí de nǚ rén
sents.en: I think she's an honest woman.

sents.zh: 她给他一件毛衣。
sents.p: tā gěi tā yī jiàn máo yī
sents.en: She gave him a sweater.

sents.zh: 她穿著羊毛衣。
sents.p: tā chuān zhù yáng máo yī
sents.en: She was dressed in wool.

sents.zh: 童年时我会去海里游泳。
sents.p: tóng nián shí wǒ huì qù hǎi lǐ yóu yǒng
sents.en: I used to go swimming in the sea when I was a child.

sents.zh: 我的童年很快乐。
sents.p: wǒ de tóng nián hěn kuài lè
sents.en: I had a happy childhood.

units.title: Travel, culture and nature
units.intro: Grammar focus: 以…为…; 随着; 稍微; a 150-character narrative

ex.zh: 五岁以下的小孩票价全免。
ex.p: wǔ suì yǐ xià de xiǎo hái piào jià quán miǎn
ex.en: There is no admission fee for children under five.

ex.zh: 你可以选择任何你想要的。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zé rèn hé nǐ xiǎng yào de
ex.en: You may choose whichever you want.

ex.zh: 他从中国回来了。
ex.p: tā cóng zhōng guó huí lai le
ex.en: He came back from China.

ex.zh: 从中选一个。
ex.p: cóng zhōng xuǎn yī gè
ex.en: Choose one from among these.

ex.zh: 我每周末都会去市区。
ex.p: wǒ měi zhōu mò dū huì qù shì qū
ex.en: I go into town every weekend.

ex.zh: 我一月份要参加考试。
ex.p: wǒ yī yuè fèn yào cān jiā kǎo shì
ex.en: I'm taking an exam in January.

ex.zh: 六七月份雨很多。
ex.p: liù qī yuè fèn yǔ hěn duō
ex.en: We have a lot of rain in June and July.

items.en: Sun Tzu, also known as Sun Wu 孙武 (c. 500 BC, dates of birth and death uncertain)

ex.zh: 你们的优点和缺点是什么？
ex.p: nǐ men de yōu diǎn hé quē diǎn shì shén me
ex.en: What are your strengths and weaknesses?

items.en: drawing room (room for arriving guests); living room

ex.zh: 我到旅馆的时候，天已经黑了。
ex.p: wǒ dào lǚ guǎn de shí hou tiān yǐ jīng hēi le
ex.en: It was dark when I reached the hotel.

ex.zh: 你知道这家旅馆吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào zhè jiā lǚ guǎn ma
ex.en: Do you know that hotel?

items.en: there's not enough time (to do sth); it's too late (to do sth)

ex.zh: 时间快来不及了。
ex.p: shí jiān kuài lái bù jí le
ex.en: We're running out of time.

items.en: to go out; to go away (on a trip etc)

ex.zh: 我父亲外出了。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn wài chū le
ex.en: My father is out.

ex.zh: 这种天气下最好待在家里不要外出。
ex.p: zhè zhǒng tiān qì xià zuì hǎo dāi zài jiā lǐ bù yào wài chū
ex.en: In this kind of weather, it's best to stay home and not go outside.

ex.zh: 我的证件丢了。
ex.p: wǒ de zhèng jiàn diū le
ex.en: I lost my papers.

items.en: will; shall; to be going to

ex.zh: 这场谈话将要持续三天。
ex.p: zhè cháng tán huà jiāng yào chí xù sān tiān
ex.en: The talks will last three days.

ex.zh: 我将要去参加会议。
ex.p: wǒ jiāng yào qù cān jiā huì yì
ex.en: I will go to the meeting.

ex.zh: 猫在桌子底下。
ex.p: māo zài zhuō zi dǐ xia
ex.en: The cat is under the table.

items.en: culinary delicacy; fine food; gourmet food

ex.zh: 这些苹果看起来很新鲜。
ex.p: zhè xiē píng guǒ kàn qǐ lai hěn xīn xiān
ex.en: These apples look very fresh.

ex.zh: 我需要新鲜空气。
ex.p: wǒ xū yào xīn xiān kōng qì
ex.en: I need fresh air.

items.en: bustling with noise and excitement; lively

ex.zh: 他点头以示鼓励。
ex.p: tā diǎn tóu yǐ shì gǔ lì
ex.en: He nodded encouragingly.

items.en: to take a walk; to go for a walk

ex.zh: 去公园散步你觉得怎么样？
ex.p: qù gōng yuán sàn bù nǐ jué de zěn me yàng
ex.en: What do you say to taking a walk in the park?

ex.zh: 没有什么比散步更好的了。
ex.p: méi yǒu shén me bǐ sàn bù gēng hǎo de le
ex.en: There's nothing better than taking a nice walk.

ex.zh: 我是据我所知最懒的人。
ex.p: wǒ shì jù wǒ suǒ zhī zuì lǎn de rén
ex.en: I am the laziest person I know.

ex.zh: 这个男孩子很懒。
ex.p: zhè gè nán hái zi hěn lǎn
ex.en: This boy is lazy.

items.en: the head of an institution whose name ends in 院

ex.zh: 她以为我是大夫。
ex.p: tā yǐ wéi wǒ shì dà fū
ex.en: She thought that I was a doctor.

ex.zh: 我父亲是个大夫。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn shì gè dà fū
ex.en: My father's a doctor.

ex.zh: 我们的火车准时来到。
ex.p: wǒ men de huǒ chē zhǔn shí lái dào
ex.en: Our train arrived on time.

ex.zh: 我禁不住想他会不会准时到。
ex.p: wǒ jīn bù zhù xiǎng tā huì bù huì zhǔn shí dào
ex.en: I cannot help wondering if he will come on time.

ex.zh: “盒子里有什么？”“什么都没有。”
ex.p: hé zi lǐ yǒu shén me shén me dōu méi yǒu
ex.en: "What's in that box?" "Nothing."

ex.zh: 这个盒子没那个盒子大。
ex.p: zhè gè hé zi méi nà gè hé zi dà
ex.en: This box isn't as big as that one.

items.en: around; from beginning to end; all around
proud of oneself; pleased with oneself; complacent
to affix a seal; to stamp; to print out (with a printer)
to search for; to look up

ex.zh: 我得查找一下我的笔。
ex.p: wǒ de chá zhǎo yī xià wǒ de bǐ
ex.en: I need to search for my pen.

sents.zh: 我需要新鲜空气。
sents.p: wǒ xū yào xīn xiān kōng qì
sents.en: I need fresh air.

sents.zh: 他点头以示鼓励。
sents.p: tā diǎn tóu yǐ shì gǔ lì
sents.en: He nodded encouragingly.

sents.zh: 去公园散步你觉得怎么样？
sents.p: qù gōng yuán sàn bù nǐ jué de zěn me yàng
sents.en: What do you say to taking a walk in the park?

sents.zh: 没有什么比散步更好的了。
sents.p: méi yǒu shén me bǐ sàn bù gēng hǎo de le
sents.en: There's nothing better than taking a nice walk.

sents.zh: 我是据我所知最懒的人。
sents.p: wǒ shì jù wǒ suǒ zhī zuì lǎn de rén
sents.en: I am the laziest person I know.

sents.zh: 这个男孩子很懒。
sents.p: zhè gè nán hái zi hěn lǎn
sents.en: This boy is lazy.

sents.zh: 她以为我是大夫。
sents.p: tā yǐ wéi wǒ shì dà fū
sents.en: She thought that I was a doctor.

sents.zh: 我父亲是个大夫。
sents.p: wǒ fù qīn shì gè dà fū
sents.en: My father's a doctor.

sents.zh: 我们的火车准时来到。
sents.p: wǒ men de huǒ chē zhǔn shí lái dào
sents.en: Our train arrived on time.

sents.zh: 我禁不住想他会不会准时到。
sents.p: wǒ jīn bù zhù xiǎng tā huì bù huì zhǔn shí dào
sents.en: I cannot help wondering if he will come on time.

sents.zh: “盒子里有什么？”“什么都没有。”
sents.p: hé zi lǐ yǒu shén me shén me dōu méi yǒu
sents.en: "What's in that box?" "Nothing."

sents.zh: 这个盒子没那个盒子大。
sents.p: zhè gè hé zi méi nà gè hé zi dà
sents.en: This box isn't as big as that one.

sents.zh: 我得查找一下我的笔。
sents.p: wǒ de chá zhǎo yī xià wǒ de bǐ
sents.en: I need to search for my pen.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar

HSK 4 · 第67单元

Travel, culture and nature

Grammar focus: 以…为…; 随着; 稍微; a 150-character narrative

units.intro: Grammar focus: 以…为…; 随着; 稍微; a 150-character narrative

ex.zh: 我每六小时量一次体温。
ex.p: wǒ měi liù xiǎo shí liáng yī cì tǐ wēn
ex.en: I took my temperature every six hours.

ex.zh: 小孩的体温一般比大人的要高。
ex.p: xiǎo hái de tǐ wēn yī bān bǐ dà ren de yào gāo
ex.en: Children generally have a higher body temperature than adults.

ex.zh: 请给我两杯苹果汁。
ex.p: qǐng gěi wǒ liǎng bēi píng guǒ zhī
ex.en: Two glasses of apple juice, please.

ex.zh: 我想要果汁。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào guǒ zhī
ex.en: I would like fruit juice.

ex.zh: 厨师每天准备不同的菜。
ex.p: chú shī měi tiān zhǔn bèi bù tóng de cài
ex.en: The cook prepares different dishes every day.

ex.zh: 我们有一位非常好的厨师。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu yī wèi fēi cháng hǎo de chú shī
ex.en: We have a very good chef.

ex.zh: 要住在郊区的话，汽车是必需的。
ex.p: yào zhù zài jiāo qū de huà qì chē shì bì xū de
ex.en: A car is a must for life in the suburbs.

ex.zh: 我们住在郊区。
ex.p: wǒ men zhù zài jiāo qū
ex.en: We live in the suburbs.

ex.zh: 请节约用电。
ex.p: qǐng jié yuē yòng diàn
ex.en: Please save electricity.

ex.zh: 这样做你能节约几个小时。
ex.p: zhè yàng zuò nǐ néng jié yuē jī gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.

items.en: to greet sb by word or action; to give prior notice

ex.zh: 他有点活泼。
ex.p: tā yǒu diǎn huó po
ex.en: He's a bit lively.

ex.zh: 我申请了签证。
ex.p: wǒ shēn qǐng le qiān zhèng
ex.en: I applied for a visa.

ex.zh: 今天比昨天暖和。
ex.p: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān nuǎn huo
ex.en: It is warmer today than yesterday.

ex.zh: 去年冬天很暖和。
ex.p: qù nián dōng tiān hěn nuǎn huo
ex.en: We had a mild winter last year.

items.en: rare; seldom seen; (formal) it's a rare pleasure to see you
elderly; old age; autumn of one's years
to divide sth into (parts); to subdivide

ex.zh: 她的演说感动了听众。
ex.p: tā de yǎn shuō gǎn dòng le tīng zhòng
ex.en: Her speech moved the audience.

ex.zh: 我们有很多听众。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu hěn duō tīng zhòng
ex.en: We had a large audience.

ex.zh: 房子着火了。
ex.p: fáng zi zháo huǒ le
ex.en: The house was in flames.

ex.zh: 纸容易着火。
ex.p: zhǐ róng yì zháo huǒ
ex.en: Paper burns easily.

ex.zh: 他喜欢骑马出行。
ex.p: tā xǐ huan jì mǎ chū xíng
ex.en: He likes to go out on horseback.

ex.zh: 从这儿看景色很美。
ex.p: cóng zhèr kàn jǐng sè hěn měi
ex.en: It is a nice view from here.

ex.zh: 请填写这份表格。

ex.en: Please fill in this form.

ex.zh: 请填好这张表格。
ex.p: qǐng tián hǎo zhè zhāng biǎo gé
ex.en: Fill out this form, please.

ex.zh: 帮我买点零食吧。
ex.p: bāng wǒ mǎi diǎn líng shí ba
ex.en: Buy me a snack.

ex.zh: 在哪儿我能找到牙膏？
ex.p: zài nǎr wǒ néng zhǎo dào yá gāo
ex.en: Where can I find toothpaste?

ex.zh: 有时间表吗？
ex.p: yǒu shí jiān biǎo ma
ex.en: Is there a timetable?

ex.zh: 请填写这份表格。
ex.p: qǐng tián xiě zhè fèn biǎo gé
ex.en: Please fill in this form.

sents.zh: 我每六小时量一次体温。

sents.p: qǐng gěi wǒ liǎng bēi píng guǒ zhī
sents.en: Two glasses of apple juice, please.

sents.zh: 我想要果汁。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào guǒ zhī
sents.en: I would like fruit juice.

sents.zh: 厨师每天准备不同的菜。
sents.p: chú shī měi tiān zhǔn bèi bù tóng de cài
sents.en: The cook prepares different dishes every day.

sents.zh: 我们有一位非常好的厨师。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu yī wèi fēi cháng hǎo de chú shī
sents.en: We have a very good chef.

sents.zh: 要住在郊区的话，汽车是必需的。
sents.p: yào zhù zài jiāo qū de huà qì chē shì bì xū de
sents.en: A car is a must for life in the suburbs.

sents.zh: 我们住在郊区。
sents.p: wǒ men zhù zài jiāo qū
sents.en: We live in the suburbs.

sents.zh: 请节约用电。
sents.p: qǐng jié yuē yòng diàn
sents.en: Please save electricity.

sents.zh: 这样做你能节约几个小时。
sents.p: zhè yàng zuò nǐ néng jié yuē jī gè xiǎo shí
sents.en: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.

sents.zh: 他有点活泼。
sents.p: tā yǒu diǎn huó po
sents.en: He's a bit lively.

sents.zh: 我申请了签证。
sents.p: wǒ shēn qǐng le qiān zhèng
sents.en: I applied for a visa.

sents.zh: 今天比昨天暖和。
sents.p: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān nuǎn huo
sents.en: It is warmer today than yesterday.

sents.zh: 去年冬天很暖和。
sents.p: qù nián dōng tiān hěn nuǎn huo
sents.en: We had a mild winter last year.

sents.zh: 她的演说感动了听众。
sents.p: tā de yǎn shuō gǎn dòng le tīng zhòng
sents.en: Her speech moved the audience.

sents.zh: 我们有很多听众。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu hěn duō tīng zhòng
sents.en: We had a large audience.

sents.zh: 房子着火了。
sents.p: fáng zi zháo huǒ le
sents.en: The house was in flames.

sents.zh: 纸容易着火。
sents.p: zhǐ róng yì zháo huǒ
sents.en: Paper burns easily.

sents.zh: 他喜欢骑马出行。
sents.p: tā xǐ huan jì mǎ chū xíng
sents.en: He likes to go out on horseback.

sents.zh: 从这儿看景色很美。
sents.p: cóng zhèr kàn jǐng sè hěn měi
sents.en: It is a nice view from here.

sents.zh: 请填写这份表格。
sents.p: qǐng tián xiě zhè fèn biǎo gé
sents.en: Please fill in this form.

sents.zh: 请填好这张表格。
sents.p: qǐng tián hǎo zhè zhāng biǎo gé
sents.en: Fill out this form, please.

sents.zh: 帮我买点零食吧。
sents.p: bāng wǒ mǎi diǎn líng shí ba
sents.en: Buy me a snack.

sents.zh: 在哪儿我能找到牙膏？
sents.p: zài nǎr wǒ néng zhǎo dào yá gāo
sents.en: Where can I find toothpaste?

sents.zh: 有时间表吗？
sents.p: yǒu shí jiān biǎo ma
sents.en: Is there a timetable?
